# Functions

## Function: Mapping prefix to variable names
```{r fx_prefix_titles}
map_prefix <- function(var_name) {
  target_prefix <- list(
    phq9_sum = "sr",
    phq8_sum = "sr",
    gad7_total = "sr",
    flourishing_flourishing = "sr",
    promisSleep_tScore = "sr",
    medTherapy_counseling = "sr",
    medTherapy_medAntiDep = "sr",
    medTherapy_medOther = "sr",
    medTherapy_bin = "sr",
    mst_LDI = "beh",
    mst_correctedRecognition = "beh",
    linguistic_negative_sentiment = "vlg",
    linguistic_i = "vlg",
    crp_dbs_mean_AB = "dbs",
    crp_plasma_mean_AB = "dbs",
    cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB = "dbs",
    Clostridium_IV_clr = "mib",
    Desulfovibrio_clr = "mib",
    Faecalibacterium_clr = "mib",
    Enterobacteriaceae_clr = "mib",
    shannon_genus_estimate = "mib"
  )

  cleaned <- gsub("^(sr|dbs|mib|vlg|beh|sea)_(base|scr|pw1|pw2|pw3|pw4|3mo)_", "", var_name)
  
  match_name <- names(target_prefix)[
    startsWith(cleaned, names(target_prefix))  # take first match
  ]

  if (length(match_name) > 0) {
    return(target_prefix[[match_name[1]]])
  } else {
    message("No Prefix Found for: ", var_name)
    return(NA)
  }
}
```

```{r title_list}
map_title <- function(var_name, title_map) {
  if (var_name %in% names(title_map)) {
    return(title_map[[var_name]])
  } else {
    cleaned <- gsub("^(sr|dbs|mib|vlg|beh|sea)_(base|scr|pw1|pw2|pw3|pw4|3mo)_", "", var_name)
  
    if (cleaned %in% names(title_map)) {
      return(title_map[[cleaned]])
    } else {
      return(var_name)
    }
  }
}

map_title_with_baseline <- function(x, title_map) {
  # Ensure input is a single string
  if (!is.character(x) || length(x) != 1) {
    stop("x must be a single string")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(x, "_base_")) {
    return("Baseline")
  } else {
    return(map_title(x, title_map))
  }
}
```

## Function: Converting dfs from wide format to long format

```{r wide_to_long_fx}
convert_long_format <- function(df_tmp, target_var_strings, constant_vars){
  
  cat("Looking for columns ending with:", paste(target_var_strings, collapse=", "), "\n")
  
  ids <- df_tmp$id
  
  df_tmp_long <- crossing(id = ids, time = 1:6) %>% 
    mutate(week = case_when(
      time == 1 ~ 0,
      time == 2 ~ 1,
      time == 3 ~ 2,
      time == 4 ~ 3,
      time == 5 ~ 4,
      time == 6 ~ 17
    ),
    time1 = recode_values(time,
                       1 ~ -4,
                       2 ~ -3,
                       3 ~ -2,
                       4 ~ -1,
                       c(5, 6) ~ 0),
    time2 = recode_values(time,
                       c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5) ~ 0,
                       6 ~ 1),
    uniqueid = paste0(id, "_", time))
  
  df_tmp_long <- df_tmp_long %>%
    left_join(df_tmp %>% 
                dplyr::select('id', all_of(constant_vars)), by = "id")
  
  for (i in seq_along(target_var_strings)) {
    target_var <- target_var_strings[i]
    print(target_var)

    df_i <- df_tmp %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(ends_with(target_var)), 
                   names_to = "var",
                   values_to = target_var,
                   values_drop_na = TRUE) %>% 
      dplyr::select(id, sr_scr_rand_group, var, !!sym(target_var)) %>%
      mutate(time = case_when(
        (substring(var, 4, 6) == 'bas' | substring(var, 5, 7) == 'bas') ~ 1,
        (substring(var, 4, 6) == 'pw1' | substring(var, 5, 7) == 'pw1') ~ 2,
        (substring(var, 4, 6) == 'pw2' | substring(var, 5, 7) == 'pw2') ~ 3,
        (substring(var, 4, 6) == 'pw3' | substring(var, 5, 7) == 'pw3') ~ 4,
        (substring(var, 4, 6) == 'pw4' | substring(var, 5, 7) == 'pw4') ~ 5,
        (substring(var, 4, 6) == '3mo' | substring(var, 5, 7) == '3mo') ~ 6
      ),
      !!sym(target_var) := as.numeric(!!sym(target_var)),
      uniqueid = paste0(id, "_", time)) %>% 
      dplyr::select(uniqueid, !!sym(target_var))

    df_tmp_long <- left_join(df_tmp_long, df_i, by = "uniqueid")
  }
  
  df_tmp_long <- df_tmp_long %>% 
    dplyr::select(-uniqueid)
  
  return(df_tmp_long)
}
```

## Function: General linear hypothesis test for long format data

```{r glht_fx}
glht_models <- function(df_tmp, out_vars, mi_results = "N", ref_level = 'hmp_full', return_results = FALSE) {
  
  if (length(out_vars) > 1){
    
    models <- vector("list", length(out_vars) * 2)
    
    for (i in seq_along(out_vars)) {
      outcome_var <- out_vars[i]
      i1 <- i * 2 - 1
      i2 <- i * 2
      formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~ time1*sr_scr_rand_group + time2*sr_scr_rand_group + (time1|id)"))
      
      if (ref_level == 'hmp_full') {
        analysis_info1 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                               linfct = c("time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active*4 + sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:time2 = 0"))
        analysis_info2 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                               linfct = c("time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc*4 + sr_scr_rand_groupuc:time2 = 0"))
      } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active') {
        analysis_info1 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                               linfct = c("time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full*4 + sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full:time2 = 0"))
        analysis_info2 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                               linfct = c("time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc*4 + sr_scr_rand_groupuc:time2 = 0"))
      }
      
      models[[i1]] <- analysis_info1
      models[[i2]] <- analysis_info2
      
      cat("\nModel:", i1, " - ", outcome_var, " full vs active:\n")
      print(summary(analysis_info1))
      
      if (ref_level == 'hmp_full') {
        cat("\nModel:", i2, " - ", outcome_var, " full vs uc:\n")
      } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
        cat("\nModel:", i2, " - ", outcome_var, " active vs uc:\n")
      }
      print(summary(analysis_info2))
    }
    
    if (return_results == TRUE){
      return(models)
    }
    
  } else {
      outcome_var <- out_vars
      formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~ time1*sr_scr_rand_group + time2*sr_scr_rand_group + (time1|id)"))
      
      if (ref_level == 'hmp_full') {
        analysis_info1 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                               linfct = c("time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active*4 + sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:time2 = 0"))
        analysis_info2 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                               linfct = c("time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc*4 + sr_scr_rand_groupuc:time2 = 0"))
      } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active') {
        analysis_info1 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                               linfct = c("time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full*4 + sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full:time2 = 0"))
        analysis_info2 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                               linfct = c("time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc*4 + sr_scr_rand_groupuc:time2 = 0"))
      }
      
      models <- list(analysis_info1, analysis_info2)
      
      cat("\nModel: 1 - ", outcome_var, " full vs active:\n")
      print(summary(analysis_info1))
      
      if (ref_level == 'hmp_full') {
        cat("\nModel: 2 - ", outcome_var, " full vs uc:\n")
      } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
        cat("\nModel: 2 - ", outcome_var, " active vs uc:\n")
      }
      print(summary(analysis_info2))
      
    if (return_results == TRUE){
      return(models)
    }
  }
  
}
```

## Function: GLHT for imputed data (long format)

```{r fx_glht_imputed}

glht_models_mi <- function(outcome_var, fit_list, return_results = FALSE) {
  L_active <- "time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active*4 + sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:time2 = 0"
  L_uc <- "time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc*4 + sr_scr_rand_groupuc:time2 = 0"
  
  active_estimates <- vector("numeric", length(fit_list$analyses))
  active_std_errors <- vector("numeric", length(fit_list$analyses))
  uc_estimates <- vector("numeric", length(fit_list$analyses))
  uc_std_errors <- vector("numeric", length(fit_list$analyses))
  
  for (j in seq_along(fit_list$analyses)) {
    model <- fit_list$analyses[[j]]
    
    active_test <- glht(model, linfct = L_active)
    active_summary <- summary(active_test)
    active_estimates[j] <- active_summary$test$coefficients
    active_std_errors[j] <- active_summary$test$sigma
    
    uc_test <- glht(model, linfct = L_uc)
    uc_summary <- summary(uc_test)
    uc_estimates[j] <- uc_summary$test$coefficients
    uc_std_errors[j] <- uc_summary$test$sigma
  }
  
  m <- length(fit_list$analyses)
  
  active_est_pooled <- mean(active_estimates)
  active_var_within <- mean(active_std_errors^2)
  active_var_between <- sum((active_estimates - active_est_pooled)^2) / (m - 1)
  active_var_total <- active_var_within + (1 + 1/m) * active_var_between
  
  # Calculate degrees of freedom using Barnard-Rubin adjustment
  active_df <- (m - 1) * (1 + active_var_within / ((1 + 1/m) * active_var_between))^2
  active_t <- active_est_pooled / sqrt(active_var_total)
  active_p <- 2 * pt(abs(active_t), df = active_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  active_ci_lower <- active_est_pooled - qt(0.975, df = active_df) * sqrt(active_var_total)
  active_ci_upper <- active_est_pooled + qt(0.975, df = active_df) * sqrt(active_var_total)
  
  uc_est_pooled <- mean(uc_estimates)
  uc_var_within <- mean(uc_std_errors^2)
  uc_var_between <- sum((uc_estimates - uc_est_pooled)^2) / (m - 1)
  uc_var_total <- uc_var_within + (1 + 1/m) * uc_var_between
  
  uc_df <- (m - 1) * (1 + uc_var_within / ((1 + 1/m) * uc_var_between))^2
  uc_t <- uc_est_pooled / sqrt(uc_var_total)
  uc_p <- 2 * pt(abs(uc_t), df = uc_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  uc_ci_lower <- uc_est_pooled - qt(0.975, df = uc_df) * sqrt(uc_var_total)
  uc_ci_upper <- uc_est_pooled + qt(0.975, df = uc_df) * sqrt(uc_var_total)
  
  cat("\nModel:", outcome_var, " full vs active (pooled):\n")
  cat("Estimate:", round(active_est_pooled, 4), 
      "Std. Error:", round(sqrt(active_var_total), 4),
      "t value:", round(active_t, 4), 
      "df:", round(active_df, 2),
      "Pr(>|t|):", round(active_p, 4), "\n")
  
  cat("\nModel:", outcome_var, " full vs uc (pooled):\n")
  cat("Estimate:", round(uc_est_pooled, 4), 
      "Std. Error:", round(sqrt(uc_var_total), 4),
      "t value:", round(uc_t, 4),
      "df:", round(uc_df, 2),
      "Pr(>|t|):", round(uc_p, 4), "\n")
  
    if (return_results) {
    return(list(
      active = list(
        estimate = active_est_pooled,
        ci_lower = active_ci_lower,
        ci_upper = active_ci_upper,
        p_value = active_p
      ),
      uc = list(
        estimate = uc_est_pooled,
        ci_lower = uc_ci_lower,
        ci_upper = uc_ci_upper,
        p_value = uc_p
      )
    ))
  }
}

```

## Function: General linear hypothesis test for moderation (long format data)

```{r glht_fx_moderation}
glht_models_moderation <- function(df_tmp, out_vars, moderator_var, mi_results = "N", return_results = FALSE) {
  
  if (length(out_vars) > 1){
    
    models <- vector("list", length(out_vars) * 2)
    
    for (i in seq_along(out_vars)) {
      outcome_var <- out_vars[i]
      i1 <- i * 2 - 1
      i2 <- i * 2
      formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~ time1*sr_scr_rand_group*", moderator_var, " + time2*sr_scr_rand_group*", moderator_var, " + (time1|id)"))
      
      
      
      analysis_info1 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                             linfct = c(paste0("time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:", moderator_var, "*4 + sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:", moderator_var, ":time2 = 0")))
      analysis_info2 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                             linfct = c(paste0("time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc:", moderator_var, "*4 + sr_scr_rand_groupuc:", moderator_var, ":time2 = 0")))
      
      models[[i1]] <- analysis_info1
      models[[i2]] <- analysis_info2
      
      cat("\nModel:", i1, " - ", outcome_var, " full vs active:\n")
      print(summary(analysis_info1))
      
      cat("\nModel:", i2, " - ", outcome_var, " full vs uc:\n")
      print(summary(analysis_info2))
    }
  } else {
      outcome_var <- out_vars
      formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~ time1*sr_scr_rand_group*", moderator_var, " + time2*sr_scr_rand_group*", moderator_var, " + (time1|id)"))
      
      analysis_info1 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                             linfct = c(paste0("time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:", moderator_var, "*4 + sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:", moderator_var, ":time2 = 0")))
      analysis_info2 <- glht(lmer(formula, data = df_tmp),
                             linfct = c(paste0("time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc:", moderator_var, "*4 + sr_scr_rand_groupuc:", moderator_var, ":time2 = 0")))
      
      models <- list(analysis_info1, analysis_info2)
      
      cat("\nModel: 1 - ", outcome_var, " full vs active:\n")
      print(summary(analysis_info1))
      
      cat("\nModel: 2 - ", outcome_var, " full vs uc:\n")
      print(summary(analysis_info2))
      
    if (return_results == TRUE){
      return(models)
    }
  }
  
}
```

## Function: Effect size computation for long format data

```{r fx_effect_size_imputed}
compute_effect_size_long <- function(estimation, data, var, preMI = c('Y', 'N'), og_df, ref_level = 'hmp_full'){
  preMI <- match.arg(preMI)
  
  if (ref_level == 'hmp_full'){
    group1_t1_term <- "time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active"
    group1_t2_term <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:time2"
  } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
    group1_t1_term <- "time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full"
    group1_t2_term <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full:time2"
  }
  
  if (preMI == 'Y') {
    sum_coef <- summary(estimation)$coefficients
    
    group1_t1_est <- sum_coef[group1_t1_term, "Estimate"]
    group1_t2_est <- sum_coef[group1_t2_term, "Estimate"]
    uc_t1_est <- sum_coef["time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc", "Estimate"]
    uc_t2_est <- sum_coef["sr_scr_rand_groupuc:time2", "Estimate"]
  } else if (preMI == 'N') {
    group1_t1_est <- summary(estimation) %>% 
      filter(term == group1_t1_term) %>% 
      pull(estimate)
    group1_t2_est <-  summary(estimation) %>% 
      filter(term == group1_t2_term) %>% 
      pull(estimate)
    uc_t1_est <- summary(estimation) %>% 
      filter(term =="time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc") %>% 
      pull(estimate)
    uc_t2_est <- summary(estimation) %>% 
      filter(term =="sr_scr_rand_groupuc:time2") %>% 
      pull(estimate)
  }
  
  var_prefix <- map_prefix(var)
  
  base_var <- ifelse(str_detect(var, '_min0'), 
                 paste0(var_prefix, '_base_', str_remove(var, '_min0')), 
                 paste0(var_prefix, '_base_', var))
  
  #stat from original df~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  

  sd_base_full <- sd((og_df %>%
                        filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('hmp_full')) %>%
                        dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% 
                        unlist()),
                     na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_base_active <- sd((og_df %>%
                        filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('hmp_active')) %>%
                        dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% 
                        unlist()),
                     na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_base_uc <- sd((og_df %>% 
                          filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('uc')) %>%
                          dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% 
                          unlist()),
                       na.rm = TRUE)

    
  # Convert mids to long format if needed for sample size calculation
  if (inherits(data, "mids")) {
    data_long <- mice::complete(data, action = "long", include = TRUE)
  } else {
    data_long <- data
  }
  
  # sample sizes from actual data~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  t1_n <- data_long %>% 
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var)),
            time <= 5) %>% 
    group_by(sr_scr_rand_group) %>% 
    summarize(unique_id = n_distinct(id), .groups = 'drop')
  
  full_t1_n <- t1_n[t1_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_full', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  active_t1_n <- t1_n[t1_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_active', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  uc_t1_n <- t1_n[t1_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'uc', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  
  t1t2_n <- data_long %>% 
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var))) %>% 
    group_by(sr_scr_rand_group) %>% 
    summarize(unique_id = n_distinct(id), .groups = 'drop')
  
  full_t1t2_n <- t1t2_n[t1t2_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_full', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  active_t1t2_n <- t1t2_n[t1t2_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_active', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  uc_t1t2_n <- t1t2_n[t1t2_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'uc', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  
  # SDs
  sd_base_activeFull <- sqrt(((full_t1_n - 1)*sd_base_full^2 + (active_t1_n - 1)*sd_base_active^2) / (full_t1_n + active_t1_n - 2))
  sd_base_ucFull <- sqrt(((full_t1_n - 1)*sd_base_full^2 + (uc_t1_n - 1)*sd_base_uc^2) / (full_t1_n + uc_t1_n - 2))
  sd_base_ucActive <- sqrt(((active_t1_n - 1)*sd_base_active^2 + (uc_t1_n - 1)*sd_base_uc^2) / (active_t1_n + uc_t1_n - 2))
  
  #~~~~~~~~Between-group effect size~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  
  full_active_smd_t1 <- (group1_t1_est * 4) / sd_base_activeFull
  full_active_ci_t1 <- ci.smd(smd = full_active_smd_t1, n.1 = full_t1_n, n.2 = active_t1_n)
  full_active_smd_t1t2 <- (group1_t1_est * 4 + group1_t2_est * 1) / sd_base_activeFull
  full_active_ci_t1t2 <- ci.smd(smd = full_active_smd_t1t2, n.1 = full_t1t2_n, n.2 = active_t1t2_n)
  
  if (ref_level == 'hmp_full'){
    group1_uc_smd_t1 <- (uc_t1_est * 4) / sd_base_ucFull
    group1_uc_ci_t1 <- ci.smd(smd = group1_uc_smd_t1, n.1 = full_t1_n, n.2 = uc_t1_n)
    group1_uc_smd_t1t2 <- (uc_t1_est * 4 + uc_t2_est * 1) / sd_base_ucFull
    group1_uc_ci_t1t2 <- ci.smd(smd = group1_uc_smd_t1t2, n.1 = full_t1t2_n, n.2 = uc_t1t2_n)
  } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
    group1_uc_smd_t1 <- (uc_t1_est * 4) / sd_base_ucActive
    group1_uc_ci_t1 <- ci.smd(smd = group1_uc_smd_t1, n.1 = active_t1_n, n.2 = uc_t1_n)
    group1_uc_smd_t1t2 <- (uc_t1_est * 4 + uc_t2_est * 1) / sd_base_ucActive
    group1_uc_ci_t1t2 <- ci.smd(smd = group1_uc_smd_t1t2, n.1 = active_t1t2_n, n.2 = uc_t1t2_n)
  }
  
  cat('\n******Between-group effect size ******\n')
  cat('\nIntervention vs Active Ctrl******\n')
  cat('time 1 x group Estimate:', group1_t1_est, '\n')
  cat('time 2 x group Estimate:', group1_t2_est, '\n')
  cat('Intervention Time 1 sample size:', full_t1_n, '\n')
  cat('Active ctrl Time 1 sample size:', active_t1_n, '\n')
  cat('Intervention overall sample size:', full_t1t2_n, '\n')
  cat('Active ctrl overall sample size:', active_t1t2_n, '\n')
  cat('post-test effect size:\n', 
      '(', group1_t1_est, '* 4) /', sd_base_activeFull, '=', full_active_smd_t1, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(full_active_ci_t1$Lower, 4), ',', round(full_active_ci_t1$Upper, 4), '\n')
  cat('overall effect size:\n', 
      '(', group1_t1_est, '* 4 +', group1_t2_est, '* 1) /', sd_base_activeFull, '=', full_active_smd_t1t2, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(full_active_ci_t1t2$Lower, 4), ',', round(full_active_ci_t1t2$Upper, 4), '\n')
  
  if (ref_level == 'hmp_full'){
    cat('\nIntervention vs Usual care******\n')
    cat('time 1 x group Estimate:', uc_t1_est, '\n')
    cat('time 2 x group Estimate:', uc_t2_est, '\n')
    cat('Intervention Time 1 sample size:', full_t1_n, '\n')
    cat('Usual care Time 1 sample size:', uc_t1_n, '\n')
    cat('Intervention overall sample size:', full_t1t2_n, '\n')
    cat('Usual care overall sample size:', uc_t1t2_n, '\n')
    cat('post-test effect size:\n', 
        '(', uc_t1_est, '* 4) /', sd_base_ucFull, '=', group1_uc_smd_t1, '\n')
    cat('95% CI:', round(group1_uc_ci_t1$Lower, 4), ',', round(group1_uc_ci_t1$Upper, 4), '\n')
    cat('overall effect size:\n', 
        '(', uc_t1_est, '* 4 +', uc_t2_est, '* 1) /', sd_base_ucFull, '=', group1_uc_smd_t1t2, '\n')
    cat('95% CI:', round(group1_uc_ci_t1t2$Lower, 4), ',', round(group1_uc_ci_t1t2$Upper, 4), '\n\n')
    group_comparisons <- c("full_vs_active", "full_vs_uc")
  } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
    cat('\nActive Ctrl vs Usual care******\n')
    cat('time 1 x group Estimate:', uc_t1_est, '\n')
    cat('time 2 x group Estimate:', uc_t2_est, '\n')
    cat('Active ctrl Time 1 sample size:', active_t1_n, '\n')
    cat('Usual care Time 1 sample size:', uc_t1_n, '\n')
    cat('Active ctrl overall sample size:', active_t1t2_n, '\n')
    cat('Usual care overall sample size:', uc_t1t2_n, '\n')
    cat('post-test effect size:\n', 
        '(', uc_t1_est, '* 4) /', sd_base_ucActive, '=', group1_uc_smd_t1, '\n')
    cat('95% CI:', round(group1_uc_ci_t1$Lower, 4), ',', round(group1_uc_ci_t1$Upper, 4), '\n')
    cat('overall effect size:\n', 
        '(', uc_t1_est, '* 4 +', uc_t2_est, '* 1) /', sd_base_ucActive, '=', group1_uc_smd_t1t2, '\n')
    cat('95% CI:', round(group1_uc_ci_t1t2$Lower, 4), ',', round(group1_uc_ci_t1t2$Upper, 4), '\n\n')
    group_comparisons <- c("active_vs_full", "active_vs_uc")
  }
  
  
  
  # Return all the effect size as a data frame
  effect_df <- data.frame(
    group = c(
      group_comparisons[1], group_comparisons[1],
      group_comparisons[2], group_comparisons[2]
    ),
    effect_type = c(
      "T1", "Overall",
      "T1", "Overall"
    ),
    d = c(
      full_active_smd_t1,
      full_active_smd_t1t2,
      group1_uc_smd_t1,
      group1_uc_smd_t1t2
    ),
    ci_lower = c(
      full_active_ci_t1$Lower,
      full_active_ci_t1t2$Lower,
      group1_uc_ci_t1$Lower,
      group1_uc_ci_t1t2$Lower
    ),
    ci_upper = c(
      full_active_ci_t1$Upper,
      full_active_ci_t1t2$Upper,
      group1_uc_ci_t1$Upper,
      group1_uc_ci_t1t2$Upper
    )
  )
  
  return(effect_df)
}
```

## Function: Effect size computation with moderator for long format data

```{r fx_effect_size_imputed_moderation}
compute_effect_size_long_moderation <- function(estimation, data, var, moderator_var, preMI = c('Y', 'N'), og_df){
  preMI <- match.arg(preMI)
  
  time1_active_mod <- paste0("time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:", moderator_var)
  time2_active_mod <- paste0("sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:", moderator_var, ":time2")
  time1_uc_mod <- paste0("time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc:", moderator_var)
  time2_uc_mod <- paste0("sr_scr_rand_groupuc:", moderator_var, ":time2")
  
  
  if (preMI == 'Y') {
    sum_coef <- summary(estimation)$coefficients
    
    active_t1_est <- sum_coef[time1_active_mod, "Estimate"]
    active_t2_est <- sum_coef[time2_active_mod, "Estimate"]
    uc_t1_est <- sum_coef[time1_uc_mod, "Estimate"]
    uc_t2_est <- sum_coef[time2_uc_mod, "Estimate"]
  } else if (preMI == 'N') {
    active_t1_est <- summary(estimation) %>% 
      filter(term == time1_active_mod) %>% 
      pull(estimate)
    active_t2_est <-  summary(estimation) %>% 
      filter(term ==time2_active_mod) %>% 
      pull(estimate)
    uc_t1_est <- summary(estimation) %>% 
      filter(term == time1_uc_mod) %>% 
      pull(estimate)
    uc_t2_est <- summary(estimation) %>% 
      filter(term == time2_uc_mod) %>% 
      pull(estimate)
  }
  
  var_prefix <- map_prefix(var)
  
  base_var <- ifelse(str_detect(var, '_min0'), 
                 paste0(var_prefix, '_base_', str_remove(var, '_min0')), 
                 paste0(var_prefix, '_base_', var))
  
  #stat from original df~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  
  full_active_sd_base <- sd((og_df %>% 
                          filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('hmp_full', 'hmp_active')) %>%
                          dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% unlist()),
                       na.rm = TRUE)
  
  full_uc_sd_base <- sd((og_df %>% 
                          filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('hmp_full', 'uc')) %>%
                          dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% unlist()),
                       na.rm = TRUE)
    
  # Convert mids to long format if needed for sample size calculation
  if (inherits(data, "mids")) {
    data_long <- mice::complete(data, action = "long", include = TRUE)
  } else {
    data_long <- data
  }
  
  # sample sizes from actual data~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  t1_n <- data_long %>% 
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var)),
            time <= 5) %>% 
    group_by(sr_scr_rand_group) %>% 
    summarize(unique_id = n_distinct(id), .groups = 'drop')
  
  full_t1_n <- t1_n[t1_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_full', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  active_t1_n <- t1_n[t1_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_active', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  uc_t1_n <- t1_n[t1_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'uc', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  
  t1t2_n <- data_long %>% 
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var))) %>% 
    group_by(sr_scr_rand_group) %>% 
    summarize(unique_id = n_distinct(id), .groups = 'drop')
  
  full_t1t2_n <- t1t2_n[t1t2_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_full', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  active_t1t2_n <- t1t2_n[t1t2_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_active', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  uc_t1t2_n <- t1t2_n[t1t2_n$sr_scr_rand_group == 'uc', 'unique_id'] %>% unlist()
  
  #~~~~~~~~Between-group effect size~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    
  # Adding the moderator mean in effect size calculation 
  moderator_mean <- mean(og_df[[moderator_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  full_active_smd_t1 <- (moderator_mean*(active_t1_est * 4)) / full_active_sd_base
  full_active_ci_t1 <- ci.smd(smd = full_active_smd_t1, n.1 = full_t1_n, n.2 = active_t1_n)
  full_active_smd_t1t2 <- (moderator_mean*(active_t1_est * 4 + active_t2_est * 1)) / full_active_sd_base
  full_active_ci_t1t2 <- ci.smd(smd = full_active_smd_t1t2, n.1 = full_t1t2_n, n.2 = active_t1t2_n)
  
  full_uc_smd_t1 <- (moderator_mean*(uc_t1_est * 4)) / full_uc_sd_base
  full_uc_ci_t1 <- ci.smd(smd = full_uc_smd_t1, n.1 = full_t1_n, n.2 = uc_t1_n)
  full_uc_smd_t1t2 <- (moderator_mean*(uc_t1_est * 4 + uc_t2_est * 1)) / full_uc_sd_base
  full_uc_ci_t1t2 <- ci.smd(smd = full_uc_smd_t1t2, n.1 = full_t1t2_n, n.2 = uc_t1t2_n)

  
  cat('\n******Mean of', moderator_var, '******\n')
  cat('\n', moderator_mean, '\n')
  
  cat('\n******Between-group effect size ******\n')
  cat('\nIntervention vs Active Ctrl******\n')
  cat('time 1 x group x ', moderator_var, ' Estimate:', active_t1_est, '\n')
  cat('time 2 x group x ', moderator_var, ' Estimate:', active_t2_est, '\n')
  cat('Intervention Time 1 sample size:', full_t1_n, '\n')
  cat('Active ctrl Time 2 sample size:', active_t1_n, '\n')
  cat('Intervention overall sample size:', full_t1t2_n, '\n')
  cat('Active ctrl overall sample size:', active_t1t2_n, '\n')
  cat('post-test effect size:\n', 
      '(', moderator_mean, '*(', active_t1_est, '* 4) /', full_active_sd_base, ') =', full_active_smd_t1, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(full_active_ci_t1$Lower, 4), ',', round(full_active_ci_t1$Upper, 4), '\n')
  cat('overall effect size:\n', 
      '(', moderator_mean, '*(', active_t1_est, '* 4 +', active_t2_est, '* 1) /', full_active_sd_base, ') =', full_active_smd_t1t2, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(full_active_ci_t1t2$Lower, 4), ',', round(full_active_ci_t1t2$Upper, 4), '\n')
  
  cat('\nIntervention vs Usual care******\n')
  cat('time 1 x group x ', moderator_var, ' Estimate:', uc_t1_est, '\n')
  cat('time 2 x group x ', moderator_var, ' Estimate:', uc_t2_est, '\n')
  cat('Intervention Time 1 sample size:', full_t1_n, '\n')
  cat('Usual care Time 2 sample size:', uc_t1_n, '\n')
  cat('Intervention overall sample size:', full_t1t2_n, '\n')
  cat('Usual care overall sample size:', uc_t1t2_n, '\n')
  cat('post-test effect size:\n', 
      '(', moderator_mean, '*(', uc_t1_est, '* 4) /', full_uc_sd_base, ') =', full_uc_smd_t1, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(full_uc_ci_t1$Lower, 4), ',', round(full_uc_ci_t1$Upper, 4), '\n')
  cat('overall effect size:\n', 
      '(', moderator_mean, '*(', uc_t1_est, '* 4 +', uc_t2_est, '* 1) /', full_uc_sd_base, ') =', full_uc_smd_t1t2, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(full_uc_ci_t1t2$Lower, 4), ',', round(full_uc_ci_t1t2$Upper, 4), '\n\n')
  
  # Return all the effect size as a data frame
  effect_df <- data.frame(
    group = c(
      "full_vs_active", "full_vs_active",
      "full_vs_uc", "full_vs_uc"
    ),
    effect_type = c(
      "T1", "Overall",
      "T1", "Overall"
    ),
    d = c(
      full_active_smd_t1,
      full_active_smd_t1t2,
      full_uc_smd_t1,
      full_uc_smd_t1t2
    ),
    ci_lower = c(
      full_active_ci_t1$Lower,
      full_active_ci_t1t2$Lower,
      full_uc_ci_t1$Lower,
      full_uc_ci_t1t2$Lower
    ),
    ci_upper = c(
      full_active_ci_t1$Upper,
      full_active_ci_t1t2$Upper,
      full_uc_ci_t1$Upper,
      full_uc_ci_t1t2$Upper
    )
  )
  
  return(effect_df)
}
```

## Function: Scale imputed values

If higher level = worse, then the scaling should be done with 1.1 and 1.2, while if lower level = worse, then it should be done with 0.8 and 0.9

```{r fx_scale_imputed}
scale_imputed_values_long <- function(df_tmp, outcome) {
  worse <- map_worse(outcome)
  
  missing_var <- paste0("missing_", outcome)
  
  if (worse == "H"){
    var110 <- paste0(outcome, "_110")
    var120 <- paste0(outcome, "_120")
    
    df_tmp <- df_tmp %>% 
      mutate(!!sym(var110) := if_else(!!sym(missing_var) == 1, 
                                      !!sym(outcome) * 1.1,
                                      !!sym(outcome)),
             !!sym(var120) := if_else(!!sym(missing_var) == 1, 
                                      !!sym(outcome) * 1.2,
                                      !!sym(outcome))
             )
  } else if (worse == "L"){
    var80 <- paste0(outcome, "_80")
    var90 <- paste0(outcome, "_90")
    
    df_tmp <- df_tmp %>% 
      mutate(!!sym(var80) := if_else(!!sym(missing_var) == 1, 
                                     !!sym(outcome) * 0.8,
                                     !!sym(outcome)),
             !!sym(var90) := if_else(!!sym(missing_var) == 1, 
                                     !!sym(outcome) * 0.9,
                                     !!sym(outcome))
             )
  }
  
  print(tail(df_tmp %>% filter(!!sym(missing_var) == 1)))
  
  return(df_tmp)
}
```


## Function: Piecewise model with imputed data

OG model

```{r fx_piecewise_original}
run_piecewise_og_long <- function(outcome, covar_formula = NULL, og_df_long = df_long, og_df_wide = df, covariates = NULL, return_table = FALSE, exc_outlier = FALSE, ref_level = 'hmp_full'){
  
  og_df_long <- og_df_long %>% 
    mutate(sr_scr_rand_group = relevel(factor(sr_scr_rand_group), ref = ref_level))
  
  if (!is.null(covariates)){
    covar_formula <- paste0(covariates, collapse=" + ")
    covar_formula <- paste0(covar_formula, "+ ")
  } else {
    covar_formula <- NULL
  }
  
  if (exc_outlier == TRUE){ #exc outlier (mean +/- >3SDs) if necessary, this will overrides og_df_wide and og_df_long!!!
    og_df_wide <- og_df_wide %>% 
      mutate(across(
        matches(outcome),
        ~ {
          x <- .
          threshold_upper <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) + 3 * sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
          threshold_lower <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) - 3 * sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
          replace(x, x >= threshold_upper | x <= threshold_lower, NA)
        }
      ))
    
    og_df_long <- convert_long_format(df_tmp = og_df_wide, 
                                      target_var_strings = outcome,
                                   constant_vars = 'sr_scr_rand_group')
  }
  
  og_formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ ", covar_formula, "time1*sr_scr_rand_group + time2*sr_scr_rand_group + (time1|id)"))
  
  cat('\n\n')
  print(og_formula)
  og_est <- lmer(og_formula, data = og_df_long)
  summary_og_est <- summary(og_est)
  fixed_effects <- summary_og_est$coefficients
  fixed_effects_rounded <- round(fixed_effects, 4)

  confint_og_est <- confint(og_est)
  confint_fixed <- confint_og_est[rownames(confint_og_est) %in% rownames(fixed_effects), ]
  confint_fixed_rounded <- round(confint_fixed, 4)

  results_table <- cbind(
    Estimate = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Estimate"],
    Std_Error = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Std. Error"],
    t_value = fixed_effects_rounded[, "t value"],
    df = fixed_effects_rounded[, "df"],
    p_value = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    `CI_2.5%` = confint_fixed_rounded[, 1],
    `CI_97.5%` = confint_fixed_rounded[, 2]
    )

  print(results_table)

  print(r.squaredGLMM(og_est))
  
  cat('\n****** Effect Size summary ******\n')
  effect_df <- compute_effect_size_long(estimation = og_est,
                        data = og_df_long,
                        var = outcome,
                        preMI = 'Y',
                        og_df = og_df_wide,
                        ref_level = ref_level)
  
  
  glht_models_all <- glht_models(og_df_long, as.character(outcome), return_results = TRUE, ref_level = ref_level)
  
  if (return_table == TRUE){
  glht_full_active <- glht_models_all[[1]]
  glht_full_active_summary <- summary(glht_full_active)
  glht_group1_uc <- glht_models_all[[2]]
  glht_group1_uc_summary <- summary(glht_group1_uc)
  
  if (ref_level == 'hmp_full'){
    group_comparison <- c("full_vs_active", "full_vs_uc")
    group_comparison_cap <- c("Full_vs_Active", "Full_vs_UC")
    group1_time1_term <- "time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active"
  } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
    group_comparison <- c("active_vs_full", "active_vs_uc")
    group_comparison_cap <- c("Active_vs_Full", "Active_vs_UC")
    group1_time1_term <- "time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full"
  }
    
  glht_table <- data.frame(
    comparison = group_comparison,
    estimate = c(coef(glht_full_active_summary)[1], coef(glht_group1_uc_summary)[1]),
    t_value = c(glht_full_active_summary$test$tstat[1], glht_group1_uc_summary$test$tstat[1]),
    p_value = c(glht_full_active_summary$test$pvalues[1], glht_group1_uc_summary$test$pvalues[1]),
    ci_lower = c(confint(glht_full_active)$confint[1, "lwr"], confint(glht_group1_uc)$confint[1, "lwr"]),
    ci_upper = c(confint(glht_full_active)$confint[1, "upr"], confint(glht_group1_uc)$confint[1, "upr"])
  )
  
   summary_table <- data.frame(
    outcome = outcome,
    comparison = rep(group_comparison_cap, each = 2),
    timepoint = rep(c("Week 4 vs. Baseline", "Week 17 vs. Baseline"), 2),
    
    # Coefficients
    coef = c(
      fixed_effects[group1_time1_term, "Estimate"],
      coef(glht_full_active_summary)[1],
      fixed_effects["time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc", "Estimate"],
      coef(glht_group1_uc_summary)[1]
    ),
    
    # Coefficient CIs
    coef_ci_lower = c(
      confint_fixed[group1_time1_term, 1],
      confint(glht_full_active)$confint[1, "lwr"],
      confint_fixed["time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc", 1],
      confint(glht_group1_uc)$confint[1, "lwr"]
    ),
    coef_ci_upper = c(
      confint_fixed[group1_time1_term, 2],
      confint(glht_full_active)$confint[1, "upr"],
      confint_fixed["time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc", 2],
      confint(glht_group1_uc)$confint[1, "upr"]
    ),
    
    # P-values
    p_value = c(
      fixed_effects[group1_time1_term, "Pr(>|t|)"],
      glht_full_active_summary$test$pvalues[1],
      fixed_effects["time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc", "Pr(>|t|)"],
      glht_group1_uc_summary$test$pvalues[1]
    ),
    
    # Effect sizes
    d = effect_df$d,
    d_ci_lower = effect_df$ci_lower,
    d_ci_upper = effect_df$ci_upper,
    
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
   
     # Round numeric columns
  summary_table <- summary_table %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
  
    return(list(model = og_est, results_summary = summary_table, ci_fixed = confint_fixed))
  }
}
```

OG model with moderator

```{r fx_piecewise_original_moderation}
run_piecewise_og_long_moderation <- function(outcome, covar_formula = NULL, og_df_long = df_long, og_df_wide = df, moderator_var, covariates = NULL, return_table = FALSE){
  if (!is.null(covariates)){
    covar_formula <- paste0(covariates, collapse=" + ")
    covar_formula <- paste0(covar_formula, "+ ")
  } else {
    covar_formula <- NULL
  }

  og_formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ ", covar_formula, "time1*sr_scr_rand_group*", moderator_var, " + time2*sr_scr_rand_group*", moderator_var, " + (time1|id)"))
  
  
  cat('\n\n')
  print(og_formula)
  og_est <- lmer(og_formula, data = og_df_long)
  summary_og_est <- summary(og_est)
  fixed_effects <- summary_og_est$coefficients
  fixed_effects_rounded <- round(fixed_effects, 4)

  confint_og_est <- confint(og_est)
  confint_fixed <- confint_og_est[rownames(confint_og_est) %in% rownames(fixed_effects), ]
  confint_fixed_rounded <- round(confint_fixed, 4)

  results_table <- cbind(
    Estimate = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Estimate"],
    Std_Error = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Std. Error"],
    t_value = fixed_effects_rounded[, "t value"],
    df = fixed_effects_rounded[, "df"],
    p_value = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    `CI_2.5%` = confint_fixed_rounded[, 1],
    `CI_97.5%` = confint_fixed_rounded[, 2]
    )

  print(results_table)

  print(r.squaredGLMM(og_est))
  
  cat('\n****** Effect Size summary ******\n')
    effect_df <- compute_effect_size_long_moderation(estimation = og_est,
                                                     data = og_df_long,
                                                     var = outcome,
                                                     moderator_var = moderator_var,
                                                     preMI = 'Y',
                                                     og_df = og_df_wide)
    
    
    
  if (return_table == TRUE){
      glht_models_all <- glht_models_moderation(og_df_long, 
                                                as.character(outcome), 
                                                moderator_var = moderator_var,
                                                return_results = TRUE)
      glht_full_active <- glht_models_all[[1]]
      glht_full_active_summary <- summary(glht_full_active)
      glht_full_uc <- glht_models_all[[2]]
      glht_full_uc_summary <- summary(glht_full_uc)
      
      glht_table <- data.frame(
        comparison = c("full_vs_active", "full_vs_uc"),
        estimate = c(coef(glht_full_active_summary)[1], coef(glht_full_uc_summary)[1]),
        t_value = c(glht_full_active_summary$test$tstat[1], glht_full_uc_summary$test$tstat[1]),
        p_value = c(glht_full_active_summary$test$pvalues[1], glht_full_uc_summary$test$pvalues[1]),
        ci_lower = c(confint(glht_full_active)$confint[1, "lwr"], confint(glht_full_uc)$confint[1, "lwr"]),
        ci_upper = c(confint(glht_full_active)$confint[1, "upr"], confint(glht_full_uc)$confint[1, "upr"])
      )
  
      time1_active_mod <- paste0("time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:", moderator_var)
      time1_uc_mod <- paste0("time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc:", moderator_var)
      time2_active_mod <- paste0("sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:", moderator_var, ":time2")
      time2_uc_mod <- paste0("sr_scr_rand_groupuc:", moderator_var, ":time2")
      
       summary_table <- data.frame(
        outcome = outcome,
        comparison = rep(c("Full_vs_Active", "Full_vs_UC"), each = 2),
        timepoint = rep(c("Week 4 vs. Baseline", "Week 17 vs. Baseline"), 2),
        
        # Coefficients
        coef = c(
          fixed_effects[time1_active_mod, "Estimate"],
          coef(glht_full_active_summary)[1],
          fixed_effects[time1_uc_mod, "Estimate"],
          coef(glht_full_uc_summary)[1]
        ),
        
        # Coefficient CIs
        coef_ci_lower = c(
          confint_fixed[time1_active_mod, 1],
          confint(glht_full_active)$confint[1, "lwr"],
          confint_fixed[time1_uc_mod, 1],
          confint(glht_full_uc)$confint[1, "lwr"]
        ),
        coef_ci_upper = c(
          confint_fixed[time1_active_mod, 2],
          confint(glht_full_active)$confint[1, "upr"],
          confint_fixed[time1_uc_mod, 2],
          confint(glht_full_uc)$confint[1, "upr"]
        ),
        
        # P-values
        p_value = c(
          fixed_effects[time1_active_mod, "Pr(>|t|)"],
          glht_full_active_summary$test$pvalues[1],
          fixed_effects[time1_uc_mod, "Pr(>|t|)"],
          glht_full_uc_summary$test$pvalues[1]
        ),
        
        # Effect sizes
        d = effect_df$d,
        d_ci_lower = effect_df$ci_lower,
        d_ci_upper = effect_df$ci_upper,
        
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
       
     # Round numeric columns
  summary_table <- summary_table %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
  
    return(list(model = og_est, results_summary = summary_table, ci_fixed = confint_fixed))
  }
}
```

## Function for imputed piecewise models
There are four models:
- Original model
- Model with imputed data
- Model with imputed data, in which the data is scaled to be 10% worse
- Model with imputed data, in which the data is scaled to be 20% worse

```{r run_sensitivity_imputed_long}
run_sensitivity_imputed_long <- function(df_tmp, outcome, 
                                         covariates = NULL, og_df_wide = df, 
                                         og_df_long = df_long, return_table = FALSE,
                                         return_models = FALSE){
  
  worse <- map_worse(outcome)
  
  if (!is.null(covariates)){
    covar_formula <- paste0(covariates, collapse=" + ")
    covar_formula <- paste0(covar_formula, "+ ")
  } else {
    covar_formula <- NULL
  }

  # Original model (unchanged)
  cat("\nOutcome:", outcome,"(Original, NOT imputed) -----------------------\n")
  orig_results <- run_piecewise_og_long(outcome,
                          covar_formula,
                          og_df_wide = og_df_wide,
                          og_df_long = og_df_long,
                          return_table = TRUE)
  
  og_summary <- orig_results$results_summary
  og_summary <- og_summary %>% 
    mutate(model_type = "Original") %>% 
    relocate(outcome, model_type)

  mids_tmp <- mice::as.mids(df_tmp)
  
  process_model <- function(outcome_name, model_label) {
    cat("\nOutcome:", outcome_name, "(", model_label, ") -----------------------\n")
    
    model_check <- with(mids_tmp,
      lmer(formula(paste(outcome_name, "~ ", covar_formula, "time1*sr_scr_rand_group + time2*sr_scr_rand_group + (time1|id)")),
           control = lmerControl(optimizer = "nloptwrap", calc.derivs = FALSE))
    )
    
    est <- pool(model_check)
    summary_est <- summary(est, conf.int = TRUE)
    summary_est[, 2:ncol(summary_est)] <- round(summary_est[, 2:ncol(summary_est)], 4)
    print(summary_est)
    
    effect_df <- compute_effect_size_long(estimation = est, data = mids_tmp, 
                                          var = outcome, preMI = 'N', og_df = og_df_wide)
    
    glht_results <- glht_models_mi(outcome_name, model_check, return_results = return_table)
    
    if (return_table) {
      time1_active_idx <- which(summary_est$term == "time1:sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active")
      time1_uc_idx <- which(summary_est$term == "time1:sr_scr_rand_groupuc")
      
      summary_table <- data.frame(
        outcome = outcome,
        model_type = model_label,
        comparison = rep(c("Full_vs_Active", "Full_vs_UC"), each = 2),
        timepoint = rep(c("Week 4 vs. Baseline", "Week 17 vs. Baseline"), 2),
        coef = c(summary_est$estimate[time1_active_idx], glht_results$active$estimate,
                summary_est$estimate[time1_uc_idx], glht_results$uc$estimate),
        coef_ci_lower = c(summary_est$`2.5 %`[time1_active_idx], glht_results$active$ci_lower,
                         summary_est$`2.5 %`[time1_uc_idx], glht_results$uc$ci_lower),
        coef_ci_upper = c(summary_est$`97.5 %`[time1_active_idx], glht_results$active$ci_upper,
                         summary_est$`97.5 %`[time1_uc_idx], glht_results$uc$ci_upper),
        p_value = c(summary_est$p.value[time1_active_idx], glht_results$active$p_value,
                   summary_est$p.value[time1_uc_idx], glht_results$uc$p_value),
        d = effect_df$d,
        d_ci_lower = effect_df$ci_lower,
        d_ci_upper = effect_df$ci_upper,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ) %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
      
      return(list(
        table = summary_table,
        model = list(
          model = model_check,
          pooled = est,
          glht = glht_results,
          effect_size = effect_df,
          outcome_name = outcome_name,
          model_type = model_label
        )
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Store results if return_table = TRUE
  if (return_table) {
    models_list <- list()
    tables_list <- list()
  }
  
  # Process all models
  result_imp <- process_model(outcome, "Imputed")
  if (return_table) {
    models_list[["original"]] <- og_summary
    models_list[["imputed"]] <- result_imp$model
    tables_list[["imputed"]] <- result_imp$table
  }
  
  if (worse == "H") {
    result_110 <- process_model(paste0(outcome, "_110"), "Imputed 110%")
    result_120 <- process_model(paste0(outcome, "_120"), "Imputed 120%")
    if (return_table) {
      models_list[["imputed_110"]] <- result_110$model
      tables_list[["imputed_110"]] <- result_110$table
      models_list[["imputed_120"]] <- result_120$model
      tables_list[["imputed_120"]] <- result_120$table
    }
  } else if (worse == "L") {
    result_90 <- process_model(paste0(outcome, "_90"), "Imputed 90%")
    result_80 <- process_model(paste0(outcome, "_80"), "Imputed 80%")
    if (return_table) {
      models_list[["imputed_90"]] <- result_90$model
      tables_list[["imputed_90"]] <- result_90$table
      models_list[["imputed_80"]] <- result_80$model
      tables_list[["imputed_80"]] <- result_80$table
    }
  }
  

  
  if (return_table) {
    return(list(
      summary_table = bind_rows(tables_list),
      models = models_list,
      outcome = outcome
    ))
  }
}
```

## Function: Set the predictor matrix and actual imputation

The df will only consist of the time, week, group, and outcome variables. If needs to add other covariates, update the pred matrix accordingly.

```{r set_the_prediction_matrix}
imputating_missing_long <- function(df_tmp, vars, pred_spec = NULL, restrict_range = c("Y", "N"), range_matrix = NULL){
  set.seed(20250314)
  
  data_long <- df_tmp %>% 
    dplyr::select(id, 
                  time,
                  week,
                  time1,
                  time2,
                  sr_scr_rand_group,
                  all_of(vars),
                  starts_with("missing_"))
  ini <- mice(data_long, maxit=0, print = FALSE)
  pred <- ini$predictorMatrix
  
  pred[,'id'] <- 0
  # pred[, 'time'] <- 0
  pred[, 'week'] <- 0
  pred[, 'time1'] <- 0
  pred[, 'time2'] <- 0
  pred[, 'sr_scr_rand_group'] <- 0
  
  #imputation method: "" = MICE selects the best one automatically; 2l.pan = best for nested continuous data
  meth <- rep("", ncol(data_long))  # Default to MICE choosing method
  names(meth) <- names(data_long)
  if (restrict_range == "Y"){
    post <- make.post(data_long)
  }
  
  for (var in vars) {
    missing_outcome <- paste0('missing_', var)
    pred[, missing_outcome] <- 0
    
    if (is.null(pred_spec)){
    pred[var, ] <- c(-2, 2, 0, 0, 0, 2, rep(2, length(vars)), rep(0, length(vars))) # Update if adding covariates
    } else {
      pred[var, ] <- pred_spec %>% 
        dplyr::select(!!sym(var)) %>% 
        unlist()
    }
    
    if (is.factor(data_long[[var]])) {
      if (length(levels(data_long[[var]])) == 2) {
        meth[var] <- "logreg"  # For binary categorical variables
        } else if (is.ordered(data_long[[var]])) {
          meth[var] <- "polr"    # For ordered categorical variables
          } else {
            meth[var] <- "polyreg" # For unordered categorical variables with >2 levels
            }
      } else if (is.numeric(data_long[[var]])){
      meth[var] <- "2l.pan"
    }
    
    if ((restrict_range == "Y") & (is.numeric(data_long[[var]]))){
      if (var %in% names(range_matrix)) {  # Ensure the variable exists in the range list
        post[var] <- paste0("imp[[j]][, i] <- squeeze(imp[[j]][,i], c(", range_matrix[[var]][1], ", ",
                            range_matrix[[var]][2], "))")
        } else {
          warning(paste("Variable", var, "not found in range_matrix, skipping restriction"))
        }
      }
  }
  
  print(pred)
  print(meth)
  
  if (restrict_range == "Y"){
    imp_tmp <- mice(data_long, 
                    pred = pred, 
                    meth = meth, 
                    maxit = 10, 
                    # print = FALSE, 
                    m = 50,
                    post = post
                    )
  } else {
    imp_tmp <- mice(data_long, 
                    pred = pred, 
                    meth = meth, 
                    maxit = 10, 
                    # print = FALSE, 
                    m = 50
                    )
  }
  
  for (var in vars) {
    missing_outcome <- paste0('missing_', var)
    miss_count <- sum(df_tmp[[missing_outcome]])
    if (miss_count > 0) {  
      print(plot(imp_tmp, var)) 
      print(densityplot(imp_tmp, as.formula(paste("~", var))))
    } else {
      print(paste("Skipping", var, "as it has no missing data and was not imputed"))
    }
  }
  
  return(imp_tmp)
}
```

## Function: Set the predictor matrix and actual imputation

df generated by this code will only consist of group, demographic variables and target variable(s). If needs to add other covariates, update the pred matrix accordingly.

```{r set_the_prediction_matrix}
imputating_missing_wide <- function(df_tmp, vars, pred_spec = NULL, restrict_range = c("Y", "N"), range_matrix = NULL){
  set.seed(20250701) 
  
  df_og <- df_tmp
  
  df_tmp <- df_tmp %>% 
    dplyr::select(id,
                  sr_scr_rand_group, 
                  all_of(vars),
                  starts_with('missing'))
  
  get_base_name <- function(var, value_range_names) {
    matched <- value_range_names[
      vapply(value_range_names, function(x) endsWith(var, x), logical(1))
    ]
    if (length(matched) == 1) matched else NA_character_
  }
  
  ini <- mice(df_tmp, maxit=0, print = FALSE)
  pred <- ini$predictorMatrix
  
  pred[,'id'] <- 0
  pred[, 'sr_scr_rand_group'] <- 0
  pred['id',] <- 0
  
  #imputation method: "" = MICE selects the best one automatically; 2l.pan = best for nested continuous data
  meth <- rep("", ncol(df_tmp))  # Default to MICE choosing method
  names(meth) <- names(df_tmp)
  
  # probably due to skewness, the plasma variable doesn't get a method chosen automatically
  crp_plasma_vars <- grep(
    "^dbs_.*_crp_.*_plasma_.*",
    names(meth),
    value = TRUE
  )
  
  if (length(crp_plasma_vars) > 0) {
    meth[crp_plasma_vars] <- "pmm"
  }
  
  if (restrict_range == "Y"){
    post <- make.post(df_tmp)
  }
  
  for (var in vars) {
    missing_outcome <- paste0('missing_', var)
    pred[, missing_outcome] <- 0
    
      if (is.null(pred_spec)){
    pred[var, ] <- c(0, 1, rep(1, length(vars)), rep(0, length(vars)))
  } else {
    pred[var, ] <- pred_spec %>% 
      dplyr::select(!!sym(var)) %>% 
      unlist()
  }
  
  # Add safety check
  if (sum(pred[var, ]) == 0) {
    warning(paste("Variable", var, "has no predictors!"))
    # Set default predictors
    pred[var, ] <- c(0, 1, rep(1, length(vars)), rep(0, length(vars)))
  }
      
  if (restrict_range == "Y" && is.numeric(df_tmp[[var]])) {
  
    base_var <- get_base_name(var, names(range_matrix))
  
    if (!is.na(base_var)) {
      post[var] <- paste0(
        "imp[[j]][, i] <- squeeze(imp[[j]][, i], c(",
        range_matrix[[base_var]][1], ", ",
        range_matrix[[base_var]][2], "))"
      )
    } else {
      warning(paste("No range found for", var))
    }
  }
  
    }
  
  print(pred)
  
  if (restrict_range == "Y"){
    imp_tmp <- mice(df_tmp, 
                    pred = pred, 
                    maxit = 10, 
                    # print = FALSE, 
                    m = 50,
                    post = post
                    )
  } else {
    imp_tmp <- mice(df_tmp, 
                    pred = pred, 
                    maxit = 10, 
                    # print = FALSE, 
                    m = 50
                    )
  }
  
  has_sufficient_data <- function(imp, var) {
    dat_long <- complete(imp, action = "long", include = TRUE)
    x <- dat_long[[var]]
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    length(x) >= 2 && length(unique(x)) > 1
  }
      
  for (var in vars) {
    missing_outcome <- paste0('missing_', var)
    miss_count <- sum(df_og[[missing_outcome]])
  
    if (miss_count > 0 && has_sufficient_data(imp_tmp, var)) {
  
      p1 <- try(plot(imp_tmp, var), silent = TRUE)
      if (!inherits(p1, "try-error")) print(p1)
  
      p2 <- try(densityplot(imp_tmp, as.formula(paste("~", var))), silent = TRUE)
      if (!inherits(p2, "try-error")) print(p2)
  
    } else {
      message("Skipping plots for ", var, 
              ": insufficient variation or no imputation")
    }
  }
    
  
  cat("\n=== MICE Logged Events ===\n")
  print(imp_tmp$loggedEvents)

  return(imp_tmp)
}
```


### Function: scale the imputed values

If higher level = worse, then the scaling should be done with 1.1 and 1.2, while if lower level = worse, then it should be done with 0.8 and 0.9

```{r fx_scale_imputed_wide}
scale_imputed_values_wide <- function(df_tmp, var) {
  worse <- map_worse(var)
  
  var_prefix <- map_prefix(var)
  
  prefixes <- c(paste0(var_prefix, '_base_'),
              paste0(var_prefix, '_pw4_'),
              paste0(var_prefix, '_3mo_'))
  
  for (prefix in prefixes){
    outcome <- paste0(prefix, var)
    missing_var <- paste0("missing_", outcome)
    
    if (!outcome %in% names(df_tmp)) next
    
    if (worse == "H"){
      var110 <- paste0(outcome, "_110")
      var120 <- paste0(outcome, "_120")
      
      df_tmp <- df_tmp %>% 
        mutate(!!sym(var110) := if_else(!!sym(missing_var) == 1, 
                                        !!sym(outcome) * 1.1,
                                        !!sym(outcome)),
               !!sym(var120) := if_else(!!sym(missing_var) == 1, 
                                        !!sym(outcome) * 1.2,
                                        !!sym(outcome))
               )
    } else if (worse == "L"){
      var80 <- paste0(outcome, "_80")
      var90 <- paste0(outcome, "_90")
      
      df_tmp <- df_tmp %>% 
        mutate(!!sym(var80) := if_else(!!sym(missing_var) == 1, 
                                       !!sym(outcome) * 0.8,
                                       !!sym(outcome)),
               !!sym(var90) := if_else(!!sym(missing_var) == 1, 
                                       !!sym(outcome) * 0.9,
                                       !!sym(outcome))
               )
    }
  }
  
  print(tail(df_tmp %>% filter(!!sym(missing_var) == 1)))
  
  return(df_tmp)
}
```

### Function: Simple linear regression model with original data

```{r fx-lm-analysis-wide}
run_lm_og_wide <- function(df_og = df, outcome, phase = '3mo', covar_formula = NULL, return_table = FALSE, exc_outlier = FALSE, ref_level = 'hmp_full'){
  
  df_og <- df_og %>%
    mutate(sr_scr_rand_group = relevel(factor(sr_scr_rand_group), ref = ref_level))
  
  var_prefix <- map_prefix(outcome)
  
  base_var <- paste0(var_prefix, '_base_', outcome)
  outcome_var <- paste0(var_prefix, '_', phase, '_', outcome)
  
  if (exc_outlier == TRUE){ # update df_og if necessary
    if (str_detect(var_prefix, "mib")){
      # only exclude > median + 1.5xIQR
        outcome_med <- median(df_og[[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
        outcome_IQR_val <- IQR(df_og[[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
        outcome_upper_bound <- outcome_med + 1.5 * outcome_IQR_val
        base_med <- median(df_og[[base_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
        base_IQR_val <- IQR(df_og[[base_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
        base_upper_bound <- base_med + 1.5 * base_IQR_val

        df_og <- df_og %>%
        mutate(!!sym(outcome_var) := ifelse((!!sym(outcome_var) > outcome_upper_bound), NA, !!sym(outcome_var)),
               !!sym(base_var) := ifelse((!!sym(base_var) > base_upper_bound), NA, !!sym(base_var)))
    } else {
      outcome_mean_y <- mean(df_og[[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      outcome_sd_y <- sd(df_og[[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      outcome_upper_y <- outcome_mean_y + 3 * outcome_sd_y
      outcome_lower_y <- outcome_mean_y - 3 * outcome_sd_y
      base_mean_y <- mean(df_og[[base_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      base_sd_y <- sd(df_og[[base_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      base_upper_y <- base_mean_y + 3 * base_sd_y
      base_lower_y <- base_mean_y - 3 * base_sd_y
      
      df_og <- df_og %>%
        mutate(!!sym(outcome_var) := ifelse((!!sym(outcome_var) > outcome_upper_y | !!sym(outcome_var) < outcome_lower_y), NA, !!sym(outcome_var)),
               !!sym(base_var) := ifelse((!!sym(base_var) > base_upper_y | !!sym(base_var) < base_lower_y), NA, !!sym(base_var)))
    }
  }
  
  cat("\nOutcome:", outcome_var,"(Original, NOT imputed) -----------------------\n")
  og_formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~ ", covar_formula, base_var, " + sr_scr_rand_group"))
  cat('\n', as.character(og_formula), '\n\n')
  og_est <- lm(og_formula, data = df_og)
  summary_og_est <- summary(og_est)
  fixed_effects <- summary_og_est$coefficients
  fixed_effects_rounded <- round(fixed_effects, 4)
  
  confint_og_est <- confint(og_est)
  confint_fixed <- confint_og_est[rownames(confint_og_est) %in% rownames(fixed_effects), ]
  confint_fixed_rounded <- round(confint_fixed, 4)
  
  results_table <- cbind(
    Estimate = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Estimate"],
    Std_Error = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Std. Error"],
    t_value = fixed_effects_rounded[, "t value"],
    p_value = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    `CI_2.5%` = confint_fixed_rounded[, 1],
    `CI_97.5%` = confint_fixed_rounded[, 2]
    )
  
  print(results_table)
  
  cat('\n****** Effect Size summary ******\n')
  effect_df <- compute_effect_size_wide(estimation = og_est, 
                                        data = df_og,
                                        base_var = base_var,
                                        outcome_var = outcome_var,
                                        preMI = 'Y',
                                        ref_level = ref_level)
  
  if (return_table == TRUE){
    if(str_detect(outcome_var, '_pw4_')){
      time_desc <- "Week 4 vs. Baseline"
      } else if (str_detect(outcome_var, '_3mo_')){
        time_desc <- "Week 17 vs. Baseline"
      }
    
    if (ref_level == 'hmp_full'){
      group_comparison <- c("Full_vs_Active", "Full_vs_UC")
      group1_term <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active"
    } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
      group_comparison <- c("Active_vs_Full", "Active_vs_UC")
      group1_term <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full"
    }
    
    summary_table <- data.frame(
      outcome = outcome,
      comparison = rep(group_comparison, each = 1),
      timepoint = rep(c(time_desc), 2),
      
      # Coefficients
      coef = c(
        fixed_effects[group1_term, "Estimate"],
        fixed_effects["sr_scr_rand_groupuc", "Estimate"]
        ),
        
      # Coefficient CIs
      coef_ci_lower = c(
        confint_fixed[group1_term, 1],
        confint_fixed["sr_scr_rand_groupuc", 1]
      ),
      coef_ci_upper = c(
        confint_fixed[group1_term, 2],
        confint_fixed["sr_scr_rand_groupuc", 2]
      ),
        
      # P-values
      p_value = c(
        fixed_effects[group1_term, "Pr(>|t|)"],
        fixed_effects["sr_scr_rand_groupuc", "Pr(>|t|)"]
      ),
        
      # Effect sizes
      d = effect_df$d,
      d_ci_lower = effect_df$ci_lower,
      d_ci_upper = effect_df$ci_upper,
      
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
     
    # Round numeric columns
    summary_table <- summary_table %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
    
    return(list(model = og_est, results_summary = summary_table, ci_fixed = confint_fixed))
    }
}
```



### Function: Simple linear regression model with imputed data

There are four models:
- Original model
- Model with imputed data
- Model with imputed data, in which the data is scaled to be 10% worse
- Model with imputed data, in which the data is scaled to be 20% worse

```{r fx-sensitvity-analysis-wide}
run_sensitivity_imputed_wide <- function(df_og, df_imp, outcome, covariates = NULL, return_table = FALSE, exc_outlier = FALSE, ref_level = 'hmp_full'){
  worse <- map_worse(outcome)
  
  df_og <- df_og %>%
    mutate(sr_scr_rand_group = relevel(factor(sr_scr_rand_group), ref = ref_level))
  
  df_imp <- df_imp %>%
    mutate(sr_scr_rand_group = relevel(factor(sr_scr_rand_group), ref = ref_level))
  
  if (!is.null(covariates)){
    covar_formula <- paste0(covariates, collapse=" + ")
    covar_formula <- paste0(covar_formula, "+ ")
  } else {
    covar_formula <- NULL
  }
  
  print(outcome)
  var_prefix <- map_prefix(outcome)
  print(var_prefix)
  
  # Remove redundant prefix from outcome name
  outcome_suffix <- sub(paste0("^", var_prefix, "_"), "", outcome)
  # outcome_suffix <- sub(paste0("_", var_prefix, "_"), "_", outcome_suffix)
  
  base_var <- paste0(var_prefix, '_base_', outcome_suffix)
  outcome_vars <- c(paste0(var_prefix, '_pw4_', outcome_suffix), 
                    paste0(var_prefix, '_3mo_', outcome_suffix))
  
  # Store results if return_table = TRUE
  if (return_table) {
    models_list <- list()
    tables_list <- list()
    ci_fixed_list <- list()
  }
  
  for (outcome_var in outcome_vars){
    # Skip if outcome variable doesn't exist
    if (!outcome_var %in% names(df_og)) {
      cat("Skipping", outcome_var, "- not found in dataframe\n")
      next
    }
    
    if (str_detect(outcome_var, 'pw4')){
      timepoint <- "Week 4 vs. Baseline"
      phase <- "pw4"
      cat("\nTime: Week 4 ===================================================================\n")
    } else if (str_detect(outcome_var, '3mo')){
      timepoint <- "Week 17 vs. Baseline"
      phase <- "3mo"
      cat("\nTime: 3-month follow-up ===================================================================\n")
    }
    
    orig_results <- run_lm_og_wide(df_og = df_og, 
                                   outcome = outcome, 
                                   phase = phase, 
                                   covar_formula = covar_formula, 
                                   exc_outlier = exc_outlier, 
                                   ref_level = ref_level,
                                   return_table = TRUE)
    
    og_summary <- orig_results$results_summary
    og_summary <- og_summary %>% 
      mutate(model_type = "Original") %>% 
      relocate(outcome, model_type)
    
    if (exc_outlier == TRUE){ #exc outlier (>3SDs) if necessary
       df_imp_exc <- df_imp %>%
        group_by(.imp) %>%
        mutate(
          mean_val = mean(!!sym(outcome_var), na.rm = TRUE),
          sd_val = sd(!!sym(outcome_var), na.rm = TRUE),
          threshold_val = (mean_val + 3*sd_val),
          !!sym(outcome_var) := ifelse(
            !!sym(outcome_var) > threshold_val,
            NA,
            !!sym(outcome_var))
          ) %>%
        mutate(
          mean_val_base = mean(!!sym(base_var), na.rm = TRUE),
          sd_val_base = sd(!!sym(base_var), na.rm = TRUE),
          threshold_val_base = (mean_val_base + 3*sd_val_base),
          !!sym(base_var) := ifelse(
            !!sym(base_var) > threshold_val_base,
            NA,
            !!sym(base_var))
          ) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::select(-mean_val, -sd_val, -threshold_val,
                      -mean_val_base, -sd_val_base, -threshold_val_base)

      mids_tmp <- mice::as.mids(df_imp_exc)
      } else {
        mids_tmp <- mice::as.mids(df_imp)
      }
    
    process_model <- function(outcome_name, scaled_perc, model_label) {
      cat("\nOutcome:", outcome_name, "(", model_label, ") -----------------------\n")
      
      outcome_var_scaled <- paste0(outcome_name, scaled_perc)
      base_var_scaled <- paste0(base_var, scaled_perc)
      
      model_check <- with(mids_tmp, 
                          lm(as.formula(paste(outcome_var_scaled, "~ ", covar_formula, base_var_scaled, " + sr_scr_rand_group"))))
      
      est <- pool(model_check)
      summary_est <- summary(est, conf.int = TRUE)
      ci_fixed <- summary_est[, c("2.5 %", "97.5 %")]
rownames(ci_fixed) <- summary_est$term
ci_fixed <- round(ci_fixed, 4)
      summary_est[, 2:ncol(summary_est)] <- round(summary_est[, 2:ncol(summary_est)], 4)
      
      print(summary_est)
      
      effect_df <- compute_effect_size_wide(estimation = est, 
                          data = mids_tmp, 
                          base_var = base_var_scaled, 
                          outcome_var = outcome_var_scaled,
                          preMI = 'N',
                          ref_level = ref_level)
      
      if (return_table) {
        if (ref_level == 'hmp_full'){
          time1_group1_idx <- which(summary_est$term == "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active")
          group_comparison = c("Full_vs_Active", "Full_vs_UC")
        } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
          time1_group1_idx <- which(summary_est$term == "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full")
          group_comparison = c("Active_vs_Full", "Active_vs_UC")
        }
        time1_uc_idx <- which(summary_est$term == "sr_scr_rand_groupuc")
        
        summary_table <- data.frame(
          outcome = outcome_name,
          model_type = model_label,
          comparison = rep(group_comparison, each = 1),
          timepoint = rep(timepoint, 2),
          coef = c(summary_est$estimate[time1_group1_idx],
                  summary_est$estimate[time1_uc_idx]),
          coef_ci_lower = c(summary_est$`2.5 %`[time1_group1_idx],
                           summary_est$`2.5 %`[time1_uc_idx]),
          coef_ci_upper = c(summary_est$`97.5 %`[time1_group1_idx],
                           summary_est$`97.5 %`[time1_uc_idx]),
          p_value = c(summary_est$p.value[time1_group1_idx],
                     summary_est$p.value[time1_uc_idx]),
          d = effect_df$d,
          d_ci_lower = effect_df$ci_lower,
          d_ci_upper = effect_df$ci_upper,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        ) %>%
          mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
        
        return(list(
          table = summary_table,
          ci_fixed = ci_fixed, 
          model = list(
            model = model_check,
            pooled = est,
            effect_size = effect_df,
            outcome_name = outcome_name,
            model_type = model_label
          )
        ))
      }
    }
    
    # Process all models
    result_imp <- process_model(outcome_var, "", "Imputed")
    if (return_table && !is.null(result_imp)) {
      og_model_key <- paste0(phase, "_original")
      tables_list[[og_model_key]] <- og_summary
      model_key <- paste0(phase, "_imputed")
      models_list[[model_key]] <- result_imp$model
      tables_list[[model_key]] <- result_imp$table
      ci_fixed_list[[model_key]] <- result_imp$ci_fixed
    }
    
    if (worse == "H") {
      result_110 <- process_model(outcome_var, "_110", "Imputed 110%")
      result_120 <- process_model(outcome_var, "_120", "Imputed 120%")
      if (return_table) {
        if (!is.null(result_110)) {
          model_key <- paste0(phase, "_imputed_110")
          models_list[[model_key]] <- result_110$model
          tables_list[[model_key]] <- result_110$table
          ci_fixed_list[[model_key]] <- result_imp$ci_fixed
        }
        if (!is.null(result_120)) {
          model_key <- paste0(phase, "_imputed_120")
          models_list[[model_key]] <- result_120$model
          tables_list[[model_key]] <- result_120$table
          ci_fixed_list[[model_key]] <- result_imp$ci_fixed
        }
      }
    } else if (worse == "L") {
      result_90 <- process_model(outcome_var, "_90", "Imputed 90%")
      result_80 <- process_model(outcome_var, "_80", "Imputed 80%")
      if (return_table) {
        if (!is.null(result_90)) {
          model_key <- paste0(phase, "_imputed_90")
          models_list[[model_key]] <- result_90$model
          tables_list[[model_key]] <- result_90$table
          ci_fixed_list[[model_key]] <- result_imp$ci_fixed
        }
        if (!is.null(result_80)) {
          model_key <- paste0(phase, "_imputed_80")
          models_list[[model_key]] <- result_80$model
          tables_list[[model_key]] <- result_80$table
          ci_fixed_list[[model_key]] <- result_imp$ci_fixed
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (return_table) {
    if (length(tables_list) == 0) {
      cat("Warning: No valid models were created for", outcome, "\n")
      return(list(
        summary_table = data.frame(),
        models = list(),
        outcome = outcome
      ))
    }
    
    return(list(
      summary_table = bind_rows(tables_list),
      ci_fixed = ci_fixed_list,
      models = models_list,
      outcome = outcome
    ))
  }
}
```


### Function: Simple linear regression model with original data and moderation

```{r fx-lm-analysis-wide-moderation}
run_lm_og_wide_moderation <- function(df_og = df, outcome, phase = '3mo', covar_formula = NULL, return_table = FALSE, moderator_var){
    var_prefix <- map_prefix(outcome)
  
    base_var <- paste0(var_prefix, '_base_', outcome)
    outcome_var <- paste0(var_prefix, '_', phase, '_', outcome)
    
    activeFull <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active"
    ucFull <- "sr_scr_rand_groupuc"
    activeFull_moderation <- paste0(activeFull, ":", moderator_var)
    ucFull_moderation <- paste0(ucFull, ":", moderator_var)
    
    cat("\nOutcome:", outcome_var,"(Original, NOT imputed) -----------------------\n")
    cat("\nModerator:", moderator_var,"-----------------------\n")

    og_formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~ ", covar_formula, base_var, " + sr_scr_rand_group*", moderator_var))

    cat('\n', as.character(og_formula), '\n\n')
    og_est <- lm(og_formula, data = df_og)
    summary_og_est <- summary(og_est)
    fixed_effects <- summary_og_est$coefficients
    fixed_effects_rounded <- round(fixed_effects, 4)
    
    confint_og_est <- confint(og_est)
    confint_fixed <- confint_og_est[rownames(confint_og_est) %in% rownames(fixed_effects), ]
    confint_fixed_rounded <- round(confint_fixed, 4)
    
    results_table <- cbind(
    Estimate = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Estimate"],
    Std_Error = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Std. Error"],
    t_value = fixed_effects_rounded[, "t value"],
    p_value = fixed_effects_rounded[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    `CI_2.5%` = confint_fixed_rounded[, 1],
    `CI_97.5%` = confint_fixed_rounded[, 2]
    )
    
    print(results_table)
    
    cat('\n****** Effect Size summary ******\n')
    effect_df <- compute_effect_size_wide_moderation(estimation = og_est, 
                                          data = df_og,
                                          base_var = base_var, 
                                          outcome_var = outcome_var,
                                          preMI = 'Y',
                                          moderator_var = moderator_var)
    
    if (return_table == TRUE){
      if(str_detect(outcome_var, '_pw4_')){
        time_desc <- "Week 4 vs. Baseline"
      } else if (str_detect(outcome_var, '_3mo_')){
        time_desc <- "Week 17 vs. Baseline"
      }
      summary_table <- data.frame(
        outcome = outcome,
        comparison = rep(c("Full_vs_Active", "Full_vs_UC"), each = 3),
        timepoint = rep(c(time_desc), 2),
        effect = effect_df$effect,
        
        # Coefficients
        coef = c(
          fixed_effects[activeFull, "Estimate"],
          fixed_effects[activeFull_moderation, "Estimate"],
          NA,
          fixed_effects[ucFull, "Estimate"],
          fixed_effects[ucFull_moderation, "Estimate"],
          NA
        ),
        
        # Coefficient CIs
        coef_ci_lower = c(
          confint_fixed[activeFull, 1],
          confint_fixed[activeFull_moderation, 1],
          NA,
          confint_fixed[ucFull, 1],
          confint_fixed[ucFull_moderation, 1],
          NA
        ),
        coef_ci_upper = c(
          confint_fixed[activeFull, 2],
          confint_fixed[activeFull_moderation, 2],
          NA,
          confint_fixed[ucFull, 2],
          confint_fixed[ucFull_moderation, 2],
          NA
        ),
        
        # P-values
        p_value = c(
          fixed_effects[activeFull, "Pr(>|t|)"],
          fixed_effects[activeFull_moderation, "Pr(>|t|)"],
          NA,
          fixed_effects[ucFull, "Pr(>|t|)"],
          fixed_effects[ucFull_moderation, "Pr(>|t|)"],   
          NA
        ),
        
        # Effect sizes
        d = effect_df$d,
        d_ci_lower = effect_df$ci_lower,
        d_ci_upper = effect_df$ci_upper,
        
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
     
       # Round numeric columns
    summary_table <- summary_table %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
    
    return(list(model = og_est, results_summary = summary_table, ci_fixed = confint_fixed))

    }
}
```
