### Function: Effect size computation for wide format data

```{r fx_effect_size_imputed_wide}
compute_effect_size_wide <- function(estimation, data, base_var, outcome_var, preMI = c('Y', 'N'), ref_level = 'hmp_full'){
  preMI <- match.arg(preMI)
  
  if (ref_level == 'hmp_full'){
    group1_term <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active"
    group_comparison <- c("full_vs_active", 
                          "full_vs_uc")
  } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
    group1_term <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full"
    group_comparison <- c("active_vs_full", 
                          "active_vs_uc")
  }
  
  if (preMI == 'Y') {
    if (inherits(estimation, "lm") && !inherits(estimation, "vglm")) {
      sum_coef <- summary(estimation)$coefficients
      
      est_activeFull <- sum_coef[group1_term, "Estimate"]
      est_ucGroup1 <- sum_coef["sr_scr_rand_groupuc", "Estimate"]
      
    } else {
      # everything else: vglm (Tobit), etc.
      coefs <- coef(estimation)
      if (is.matrix(coefs)) coefs <- coefs[, 1]
      
      est_activeFull <- coefs[group1_term]
      est_ucGroup1 <- coefs["sr_scr_rand_groupuc"]
    }

  } else if (preMI == 'N') {
  est_activeFull <- summary(estimation) %>% 
    filter(term == group1_term) %>% 
    pull(estimate)
  est_ucGroup1 <- summary(estimation) %>% 
    filter(term == "sr_scr_rand_groupuc") %>% 
    pull(estimate)
  }
  
  if (inherits(data, "mids")) {
    # Use the first imputed dataset for calculating sample sizes and SDs
    data <- mice::complete(data, action = 1)
  } 
  
  #stat from original df~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  full_n <- data %>% filter(sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_full' & 
                            !is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                            !is.na(!!sym(outcome_var))) %>% nrow()
  active_n <- data %>% filter(sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_active' & 
                            !is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                            !is.na(!!sym(outcome_var))) %>% nrow()
  uc_n <- data %>% filter(sr_scr_rand_group == 'uc' & 
                            !is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                            !is.na(!!sym(outcome_var))) %>% nrow()
  sd_base_full <- sd((data %>%
                        filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('hmp_full')) %>%
                        dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% 
                        unlist()),
                     na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_base_active <- sd((data %>%
                        filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('hmp_active')) %>%
                        dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% 
                        unlist()),
                     na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_base_uc <- sd((data %>% 
                          filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('uc')) %>%
                          dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% 
                          unlist()),
                       na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_base_activeFull <- sqrt(((full_n - 1)*sd_base_full^2 + (active_n - 1)*sd_base_active^2) / (full_n + active_n - 2))
  sd_base_ucFull <- sqrt(((full_n - 1)*sd_base_full^2 + (uc_n - 1)*sd_base_uc^2) / (full_n + uc_n - 2))
  sd_base_ucActive <- sqrt(((active_n - 1)*sd_base_active^2 + (uc_n - 1)*sd_base_uc^2) / (active_n + uc_n - 2))
  #~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  
  smd_activeFull <- est_activeFull / sd_base_activeFull
  ci_activeFull <- ci.smd(smd = smd_activeFull, n.1 = full_n, n.2 = active_n)
  
  cat('\nIntervention vs Active Ctrl******\n')
  cat('time 1 x group Estimate:', est_activeFull, '\n')
  cat('Intervention sample size:', full_n, '\n')
  cat('Active Ctrl sample size:', active_n, '\n')
  cat('Intervention baseline SD:', round(sd_base_full, 4), '\n')
  cat('Active Ctrl baseline SD:', round(sd_base_active, 4), '\n')
  cat('Pooled SD:', round(sd_base_activeFull, 4), '\n')
  cat('Effect size:\n', 
      est_activeFull, ' /', sd_base_activeFull, '=', smd_activeFull, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(ci_activeFull$Lower, 4), ',', round(ci_activeFull$Upper, 4), '\n')
  
  #~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  if (ref_level == 'hmp_full'){
    smd_ucGroup1 <- est_ucGroup1 / sd_base_ucFull
    ci_ucGroup1 <- ci.smd(smd = smd_ucGroup1, n.1 = full_n, n.2 = uc_n)
    
    cat('\nIntervention vs Usual Care******\n')
    cat('time 1 x group Estimate:', est_ucGroup1, '\n')
    cat('Intervention sample size:', full_n, '\n')
    cat('Usual Care sample size:', uc_n, '\n')
    cat('Intervention baseline SD:', round(sd_base_full, 4), '\n')
    cat('Usual Care baseline SD:', round(sd_base_uc, 4), '\n')
    cat('Pooled SD:', round(sd_base_ucFull, 4), '\n')
    cat('Effect size:\n', 
        est_ucGroup1, ' /', sd_base_ucFull, '=', smd_ucGroup1, '\n')
    cat('95% CI:', round(ci_ucGroup1$Lower, 4), ',', round(ci_ucGroup1$Upper, 4), '\n')
  } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
    smd_ucGroup1 <- est_ucGroup1 / sd_base_ucActive
    ci_ucGroup1 <- ci.smd(smd = smd_ucGroup1, n.1 = active_n, n.2 = uc_n)
    
    cat('\nActive Ctrl vs Usual Care******\n')
    cat('time 1 x group Estimate:', est_ucGroup1, '\n')
    cat('Active Ctrl sample size:', active_n, '\n')
    cat('Usual Care sample size:', uc_n, '\n')
    cat('Active Ctrl baseline SD:', round(sd_base_active, 4), '\n')
    cat('Usual Care baseline SD:', round(sd_base_uc, 4), '\n')
    cat('Pooled SD:', round(sd_base_ucActive, 4), '\n')
    cat('Effect size:\n', 
        est_ucGroup1, ' /', sd_base_ucActive, '=', smd_ucGroup1, '\n')
    cat('95% CI:', round(ci_ucGroup1$Lower, 4), ',', round(ci_ucGroup1$Upper, 4), '\n')
  }
  
  
  effect_df <- data.frame(
    group = group_comparison,
    effect_type = c(
      "T1",
      "T1"
    ),
    d = c(
      smd_activeFull,
      smd_ucGroup1
    ),
    ci_lower = c(
      ci_activeFull$Lower,
      ci_ucGroup1$Lower
    ),
    ci_upper = c(
      ci_activeFull$Upper,
      ci_ucGroup1$Upper
    )
  )
  
  return(effect_df)
}
```


### Function: Effect size computation with moderation for wide format data

```{r fx_effect_size_imputed_wide_moderation}
compute_effect_size_wide_moderation <- function(estimation, data, base_var, outcome_var, preMI = c('Y', 'N'), moderator_var){
  preMI <- match.arg(preMI)
  
  active_moderation <- paste0("sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active:", moderator_var)
  uc_moderation <- paste0("sr_scr_rand_groupuc:", moderator_var)  
    
  if (preMI == 'Y') {
    sum_coef <- summary(estimation)$coefficients
    
    est_activeFull <- sum_coef["sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active", "Estimate"]
    est_activeFull_moderation <- sum_coef[active_moderation, "Estimate"]
    est_ucFull <- sum_coef["sr_scr_rand_groupuc", "Estimate"]
    est_ucFull_moderation <- sum_coef[uc_moderation, "Estimate"]
  } else if (preMI == 'N') {
  est_activeFull <- summary(estimation) %>% 
    filter(term == "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active") %>% 
    pull(estimate)
  est_activeFull_moderation <- summary(estimation) %>% 
    filter(term == active_moderation) %>% 
    pull(estimate)
  est_ucFull <- summary(estimation) %>% 
    filter(term == "sr_scr_rand_groupuc") %>% 
    pull(estimate)
  est_ucFull_moderation <- summary(estimation) %>% 
    filter(term == uc_moderation) %>% 
    pull(estimate)
  }
  
  if (inherits(data, "mids")) {
    # Use the first imputed dataset for calculating sample sizes and SDs
    data <- mice::complete(data, action = 1)
  } 
  
  #stat from original df~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  full_n <- data %>% filter(sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_full' & 
                            !is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                            !is.na(!!sym(outcome_var))) %>% nrow()
  active_n <- data %>% filter(sr_scr_rand_group == 'hmp_active' & 
                            !is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                            !is.na(!!sym(outcome_var))) %>% nrow()
  uc_n <- data %>% filter(sr_scr_rand_group == 'uc' & 
                            !is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                            !is.na(!!sym(outcome_var))) %>% nrow()

  sd_base_full <- sd((data %>%
                        filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('hmp_full')) %>%
                        dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% 
                        unlist()),
                     na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_base_active <- sd((data %>%
                        filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('hmp_active')) %>%
                        dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% 
                        unlist()),
                     na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_base_uc <- sd((data %>% 
                          filter(sr_scr_rand_group %in% c('uc')) %>%
                          dplyr::select(!!sym(base_var)) %>% 
                          unlist()),
                       na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_base_activeFull <- sqrt(((full_n - 1)*sd_base_full^2 + (active_n - 1)*sd_base_active^2) / (full_n + active_n - 2))
  sd_base_ucFull <- sqrt(((full_n - 1)*sd_base_full^2 + (uc_n - 1)*sd_base_uc^2) / (full_n + uc_n - 2))
  
  #~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  
  # mean of moderator
  moderator_mean <- mean(data[[moderator_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  smd_activeFull <- est_activeFull / sd_base_activeFull
  ci_activeFull <- ci.smd(smd = smd_activeFull, n.1 = full_n, n.2 = active_n)
  
  smd_activeFull_moderation <- (est_activeFull_moderation*moderator_mean) / sd_base_activeFull
  ci_activeFull_moderation <- ci.smd(smd = smd_activeFull_moderation, n.1 = full_n, n.2 = active_n)
  
  smd_activeFull_full <- (est_activeFull + (est_activeFull_moderation*moderator_mean)) / sd_base_activeFull
  ci_activeFull_full <- ci.smd(smd = smd_activeFull_full, n.1 = full_n, n.2 = active_n)
  
  cat('\nMean of', moderator_var ,'******\n')
  cat(moderator_mean, '\n')
  
  cat('\nIntervention vs Active Ctrl******\n')
  cat('Group Estimate:', est_activeFull, '\n')
  cat('Group *', moderator_var, 'Estimate:', est_activeFull_moderation, '\n')
  cat('Intervention sample size:', full_n, '\n')
  cat('Active Ctrl sample size:', active_n, '\n')
  cat('Group effect size:\n', 
      est_activeFull, ' /', sd_base_activeFull, '=', smd_activeFull, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(ci_activeFull$Lower, 4), ',', round(ci_activeFull$Upper, 4), '\n')
  
  cat('Interaction effect size:\n', 
      est_activeFull_moderation, '*', moderator_mean, '/', sd_base_activeFull, '=', smd_activeFull_moderation, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(ci_activeFull_moderation$Lower, 4), ',', round(ci_activeFull_moderation$Upper, 4), '\n')
  
  cat('Full treatment effect size:\n', 
      '(', est_activeFull, '+ (', est_activeFull_moderation, '*', moderator_mean, '))/', sd_base_activeFull, '=', smd_activeFull_full, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(ci_activeFull_full$Lower, 4), ',', round(ci_activeFull_full$Upper, 4), '\n')
  
  #~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  
  smd_ucFull <- est_ucFull / sd_base_ucFull
  ci_ucFull <- ci.smd(smd = smd_ucFull, n.1 = full_n, n.2 = uc_n)
  
  smd_ucFull_moderation <- (est_ucFull_moderation*moderator_mean) / sd_base_ucFull
  ci_ucFull_moderation <- ci.smd(smd = smd_ucFull_moderation, n.1 = full_n, n.2 = uc_n)
  
  smd_ucFull_full <- (est_ucFull + (est_ucFull_moderation*moderator_mean)) / sd_base_ucFull
  ci_ucFull_full <- ci.smd(smd = smd_ucFull_full, n.1 = full_n, n.2 = uc_n)
  
  cat('\nIntervention vs Usual Care******\n')
  cat('Group Estimate:', est_ucFull, '\n')
  cat('Group *', moderator_var, 'Estimate:', est_ucFull_moderation, '\n')
  cat('Intervention sample size:', full_n, '\n')
  cat('Usual Care sample size:', uc_n, '\n')
  cat('Group effect size:\n', 
      est_ucFull, ' /', sd_base_ucFull, '=', smd_ucFull, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(ci_ucFull$Lower, 4), ',', round(ci_ucFull$Upper, 4), '\n')
  
  cat('Interaction effect size:\n', 
      est_ucFull_moderation, '*', moderator_mean, '/', sd_base_ucFull, '=', smd_ucFull_moderation, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(ci_ucFull_moderation$Lower, 4), ',', round(ci_ucFull_moderation$Upper, 4), '\n')
  
  cat('Full treatment effect size:\n', 
      '(', est_ucFull, '+ (', est_ucFull_moderation, '*', moderator_mean, '))/', sd_base_ucFull, '=', smd_ucFull_full, '\n')
  cat('95% CI:', round(ci_ucFull_full$Lower, 4), ',', round(ci_ucFull_full$Upper, 4), '\n')
  
  effect_df <- data.frame(
    group = c(
      "full_vs_active", "full_vs_active", "full_vs_active", 
      "full_vs_uc", "full_vs_uc", "full_vs_uc"
    ),
    effect_type = c(
      "T1", "T1", "T1",
      "T1", "T1","T1"
    ),
    effect = c(
      "Group", "Interaction", "Full effect",
      "Group", "Interaction", "Full effect"
      ),
    d = c(
      smd_activeFull, smd_activeFull_moderation, smd_activeFull_full,
      smd_ucFull, smd_ucFull_moderation, smd_ucFull_full
    ),
    ci_lower = c(
      ci_activeFull$Lower, ci_activeFull_moderation$Lower, ci_activeFull_full$Lower,
      ci_ucFull$Lower, ci_ucFull_moderation$Lower, ci_ucFull_full$Lower
    ),
    ci_upper = c(
      ci_activeFull$Upper, ci_activeFull_moderation$Upper, ci_activeFull_full$Upper,
      ci_ucFull$Upper, ci_ucFull_moderation$Upper, ci_ucFull_full$Upper
    )
  )
  
  return(effect_df)
}
```

## DBS functions
### For tables
```{r dbs_tables}

dbs_results <- function(est, target_var, smd_results, model_name, ref_level = 'hmp_full'){

# extract coef and CI
# lm: uses confint(), which uses t — correct for OLS
# vglm: uses 1.96 * se — correct for MLE/Tobit
  if (inherits(est, "lm") && !inherits(est, "vglm")) {
    summary_est <- summary(est)
    fixed_effects <- summary_est$coefficients
    
    confint_est <- confint(est)
    confint_fixed <- confint_est[rownames(confint_est) %in% rownames(fixed_effects), ]
  
  } else {
    # vglm / Tobit
    summary_est <- summary(est)
    coef_mat <- coef(summary_est)  # matrix with Estimate, Std. Error, z, p
    
    # Keep only the mean equation rows (drop the log(scale) row for Tobit)
    fixed_effects <- coef_mat[!grepl("^log\\(scale\\)", rownames(coef_mat)), , drop = FALSE]
    
    z <- qnorm(0.975)
    se <- fixed_effects[, "Std. Error"]
    estimate <- fixed_effects[, "Estimate"]
        
    # p-value column is actually Pr(>|z|) 
    # Rename p-value column to match lm's "Pr(>|t|)" so table indexing works uniformly
    p_col <- grep("^Pr", colnames(fixed_effects), value = TRUE)
    colnames(fixed_effects)[colnames(fixed_effects) == p_col] <- "Pr(>|t|)"
    
    confint_fixed <- cbind(
      "2.5 %"  = estimate - z * se,
      "97.5 %" = estimate + z * se
    )
  }
    
    fixed_effects_rounded <- round(fixed_effects, 4)
    confint_fixed_rounded <- round(confint_fixed, 4)

    time_desc <- "Week 17 vs. Baseline"
    
      
  if (ref_level == 'hmp_full'){
    group1_term <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active"
    group_comparison <- c("Full_vs_Active", 
                          "Full_vs_UC")
  } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active'){
    group1_term <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full"
    group_comparison <- c("Active_vs_Full", 
                          "Active_vs_UC")
  }
    
    summary_table <- data.frame(
        outcome = target_var,
        comparison = rep(group_comparison, each = 1),
        timepoint = rep(c(time_desc), 2),
        model = model_name,
        
        # Coefficients
        coef = c(
          fixed_effects[group1_term, "Estimate"],
          fixed_effects["sr_scr_rand_groupuc", "Estimate"]
        ),
        
        # Coefficient CIs
        coef_ci_lower = c(
          confint_fixed[group1_term, 1],
          confint_fixed["sr_scr_rand_groupuc", 1]
        ),
        coef_ci_upper = c(
          confint_fixed[group1_term, 2],
          confint_fixed["sr_scr_rand_groupuc", 2]
        ),
        
        # P-values
        p_value = c(
          fixed_effects[group1_term, "Pr(>|t|)"],
          fixed_effects["sr_scr_rand_groupuc", "Pr(>|t|)"]
        ),
        
        # Effect sizes
        d = smd_results$d,
        d_ci_lower = smd_results$ci_lower,
        d_ci_upper = smd_results$ci_upper,
        
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
     
       # Round numeric columns
    summary_table <- summary_table %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
    
    return(list(
      summary_table = summary_table,
      ci_fixed = confint_fixed_rounded
    ))
}
```

### Function: Tobit effect size
```{r tobit_effect_size}
compute_effect_size_tobit <- function(fit, data, base_var, outcome_var, 
                                       ref_level = 'hmp_full', left_val, B = 2000, seed = 20260521) {
  
  if (ref_level == 'hmp_full') {
    group1_term    <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_active"
    group_comparison <- c("full_vs_active", "full_vs_uc")
  } else if (ref_level == 'hmp_active') {
    group1_term    <- "sr_scr_rand_grouphmp_full"
    group_comparison <- c("active_vs_full", "active_vs_uc")
  }
  
  beta_names   <- c(group1_term, "sr_scr_rand_groupuc")
  log_sig_name <- "(Intercept):2"
  
  # ── Point estimates ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cf        <- coef(fit)
  sigma_hat <- exp(cf[log_sig_name])
  d_hat     <- cf[beta_names] / sigma_hat
  
  # ── Bootstrap CIs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  boot_one <- function(i) {
    idx   <- sample.int(nrow(data), replace = TRUE)
    fit_b <- tryCatch(
      vglm(formula(fit),
           family = tobit(Lower = left_val),
           data   = data[idx, ]),
      error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit_b)) return(rep(NA_real_, length(beta_names)))
    
    cf_b  <- coef(fit_b)
    
    if (!all(c(beta_names, log_sig_name) %in% names(cf_b))) return(rep(NA_real_, length(beta_names)))
    
    sig_b <- exp(cf_b[log_sig_name])
    
    unname(cf_b[beta_names] / sig_b)
  }
  
  set.seed(seed)
  boot_mat <- t(sapply(seq_len(B), boot_one))
  
  prop_failed <- mean(is.na(boot_mat[, 1]))
  if (prop_failed > 0.05) warning(sprintf("%.1f%% of bootstrap resamples failed to converge", prop_failed * 100))
  
  ci_lower <- apply(boot_mat, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  ci_upper <- apply(boot_mat, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ── Diagnostic printout ─────────────
  cat('\nTobit SMD (sigma from model)\n')
  cat('sigma_hat:', round(sigma_hat, 4), '\n')
  cat(sprintf('%s  d = %.4f  95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f]\n',
              group_comparison[1], d_hat[1], ci_lower[1], ci_upper[1]))
  cat(sprintf('%s  d = %.4f  95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f]\n',
              group_comparison[2], d_hat[2], ci_lower[2], ci_upper[2]))
  cat(sprintf('Bootstrap convergence failures: %.1f%%\n', prop_failed * 100))
  
  # ── Return in same shape as compute_effect_size_wide ─────────────────────────
  effect_df <- data.frame(
    group      = group_comparison,
    effect_type = "T1",
    d          = unname(d_hat),
    ci_lower   = unname(ci_lower),
    ci_upper   = unname(ci_upper)
  )
  
  return(effect_df)
}
```


### Function: Tobit regression for DBS data
```{r tobit_comparison}
tobit_comparison_eh <- function(df_tmp, target_var, exc_outlier = FALSE, ref_level = 'hmp_full'){
  model_list <- list()
  df_tmp <- df_tmp %>%
    mutate(sr_scr_rand_group = relevel(factor(sr_scr_rand_group), ref = ref_level))
  
  # create baseline appending dbs_base to target
  base_var <- paste0('dbs_base_', target_var)
  # create followup (3mo) appending dbs_3mo to target 
  fu_var <- paste0('dbs_3mo_', target_var)
  
   # --- LLD / left-censoring for Tobit ---
  left_val <- ifelse(
    str_detect(target_var, "il6|il10"), 0.4,
    ifelse(str_detect(target_var, "tnf"), 0.9, NA_real_))  # CRP or other uncensored
  
  if (exc_outlier == TRUE){
    mean_y <- mean(df_tmp[[fu_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_y <- sd(df_tmp[[fu_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    threshold_upper_y <- mean_y + 3 * sd_y
    threshold_lower_y <- mean_y - 3 * sd_y
    
    mean_base <- mean(df_tmp[[base_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_base <- sd(df_tmp[[base_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    threshold_upper_base <- mean_base + 3 * sd_base
    threshold_lower_base <- mean_base - 3 * sd_base
    
    df_tmp <- df_tmp %>%
      mutate(!!sym(fu_var) := ifelse(
               !!sym(fu_var) > threshold_upper_y | !!sym(fu_var) < threshold_lower_y,
               NA, !!sym(fu_var)),
             !!sym(base_var) := ifelse(
               !!sym(base_var) > threshold_upper_base | !!sym(base_var) < threshold_lower_base,
               NA, !!sym(base_var)))
    }


  
  # filters CRP>10
  df_tmp_exc2 <- df_tmp |> 
    filter(dbs_base_crp_plasma_mean_AB <= 10 &
           dbs_3mo_crp_plasma_mean_AB <= 10)
  threshold_string <- "CRP > 10 at baseline or 3mo"

# residual plotting 
plot_residuals <- function(model, df, model_name, target_var) {
  # identify which vars the model used 
  model_vars <- all.vars(formula(model)) 
  
  # find rows w complete data on those vars 
  #used_rows <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df)), model@na.action) 
  rows_used <- which(complete.cases(df[, model_vars, drop = FALSE]))
  
  # extract residuals aligned with rows_used 
  res <- residuals(model, type = "response")
  #res <- res[seq_along(used_rows)] # keep only real obsv 
  
  # create full-length residual vector 
  res_full <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
  res_full[rows_used] <- res 

  # build plotting df              
  residuals_df <- data.frame(Residuals = res_full, Group = df$sr_scr_rand_group)
  
  # plot
  ggplot(residuals_df, aes(x = as.factor(Group), y = Residuals, fill = as.factor(Group))) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, color = "black") +  
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +  
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 1, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") + 
    labs(
      title = paste("Residuals Violin Plot:", target_var, "-", model_name), 
      x = "Randomization Group", 
      y = "Residuals"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}

  # Formula for ALL models: 
  formula_full <- as.formula(paste0(fu_var, "~ sr_base_curhealth_2infection + sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection + ", base_var, " + sr_scr_rand_group"))
  ## formula_simple is for analyses that exclude anyone with 2+ infection sx 
  formula_simple <- as.formula(paste0(fu_var, "~", base_var, " + sr_scr_rand_group")) 
  
  # run tobit 
  run_model <- function(formula, data, model_name) {
    if(!is.na(left_val)) {
      model <- vglm(formula, tobit(Lower = left_val), data = data)
    } else {
      model <- lm(formula, data = data)
    }
    return(model)
  }
  
  cat("Running tobit regression model for:", target_var, "========================================\n")
  # Model 1: all samples, infectious symptoms as covariate
  cat("Model 1: Run all samples with infectious symptoms as covariate------------\n")
  
  print(describeBy(df_tmp %>% dplyr::select(contains(target_var)), group = df_tmp$sr_scr_rand_group, digits = 3))
  
  model1 <- run_model(formula_full, df_tmp, "Model 1")
  
  cat('\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\nModel 1: ', 'dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ sr_base_curhealth_2infection + sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection + dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group', '\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\n')
  
  print(summary(model1))
  print(plot_residuals(model1, df_tmp, "Model 1", target_var))
  
  lm_model_1_d <- compute_effect_size_tobit(fit = model1, 
                                            data = df_tmp %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(base_var)) & !is.na(!!sym(fu_var))), 
                                            base_var = base_var,
                                            outcome_var = fu_var,
                                            left_val = left_val,
                                            ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model1_results_all <- dbs_results(est = model1,
                                   target_var = target_var,
                                   smd_results =lm_model_1_d,
                                   model_name = "Original",
                                   ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model1_results <- lm_model1_results_all$summary_table
  lm_model1_ci <- lm_model1_results_all$ci_fixed
  model_list[["Original"]] <- model1
  
  
  # Model 2: excluding CRP >10, infectious symptoms as covariate 
  cat("\nModel 2: Re-run excluding CRP > 10 with infectious symptoms as covariate------------\n")
  print(describeBy(df_tmp_exc2 %>% 
                     dplyr::select(contains(target_var)), group = df_tmp_exc2$sr_scr_rand_group, digits = 3))
  
  model2 <- run_model(formula_full, df_tmp_exc2, "Model 2") 
  
  cat('\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\nModel 2: ', 'dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ sr_base_curhealth_2infection + sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection + dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group', '\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\n')

  print(summary(model2))
  print(plot_residuals(model2, df_tmp, "Model 2", target_var))
  
    
  lm_model_2_d <- compute_effect_size_tobit(fit = model2,
                                            data = df_tmp_exc2 %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                                                                            !is.na(!!sym(fu_var))),
                                            base_var = base_var,
                                            outcome_var = fu_var,
                                            left_val = left_val,
                                            ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model2_results_all <- dbs_results(est = model2,
                                   target_var = target_var,
                                    smd_results =lm_model_2_d,
                                    model_name = "Excluding CRP>10 with infectious symptoms as covariate",
                                   ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model2_results <- lm_model2_results_all$summary_table
  lm_model2_ci <- lm_model2_results_all$ci_fixed
  model_list[["crp"]] <- model2
  
  
  # Model 3 excludes those w 2+ infectious symptoms at baseline or 3mo 
  cat("\nModel 3: Re-run excluding those with 2+ infectious symptoms at baseline OR 3mo------------\n")

  df_tmp_exc3 <- df_tmp %>%  
    filter(sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection ==0 & 
             sr_base_curhealth_2infection ==0)
  
  print(describeBy(df_tmp_exc3 %>% dplyr::select(contains(target_var)), group = df_tmp_exc3$sr_scr_rand_group, digits = 3))
  
  model3 <- run_model(formula_simple, df_tmp_exc3, "Model 3")
  
  cat('\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\nModel 3: ', 'dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group', '\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\n')
  
  print(summary(model3))
  print(plot_residuals(model3, df_tmp, "Model 3", target_var))
  
  
  lm_model_3_d <- compute_effect_size_tobit(fit = model3,
                                            data = df_tmp_exc3 %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                                                                            !is.na(!!sym(fu_var))),
                                            base_var = base_var,
                                            outcome_var = fu_var,
                                            left_val = left_val,
                                            ref_level = ref_level)
  
  lm_model3_results_all <- dbs_results(est = model3,
                                   target_var = target_var,
                                    smd_results =lm_model_3_d,
                                    model_name = "Excluding those with 2+ infectious symptoms at Baseline or Week 17",
                                   ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model3_results <- lm_model3_results_all$summary_table
  lm_model3_ci <- lm_model3_results_all$ci_fixed
  model_list[["infection"]] <- model3
  
  
    # Model 4 excludes those w 2+ infectious symptoms at baseline or 3mo AND any >10 CRP 
  cat("\nModel 4: Re-run excluding CRP > 10 and those with 2+ infectious symptoms at baseline OR 3mo------------\n")

  df_tmp_exc4 <- df_tmp_exc2 %>%  
    filter(sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection == 0 & 
             sr_base_curhealth_2infection == 0)
  
  print(describeBy(df_tmp_exc4 %>% dplyr::select(contains(target_var)), group = df_tmp_exc4$sr_scr_rand_group, digits = 3))
  
  model4 <- run_model(formula_simple, df_tmp_exc4, "Model 4")
  
  cat('\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\nModel 4: ', 'dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group', '\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\n')
  
  print(summary(model4))
  print(plot_residuals(model4, df_tmp, "Model 4", target_var))
  
    
  lm_model_4_d <- compute_effect_size_tobit(fit = model4,
                                            data = df_tmp_exc4 %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                                                                            !is.na(!!sym(fu_var))),
                                            base_var = base_var,
                                            outcome_var = fu_var,
                                            left_val = left_val,
                                            ref_level = ref_level)
  
  lm_model4_results_all <- dbs_results(est = model4,
                                   target_var = target_var,
                                    smd_results =lm_model_4_d,
                                    model_name = "Excluding CRP>10 and those with 2+ infectious symptoms at Baseline or Week 17",
                                   ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model4_results <- lm_model4_results_all$summary_table
  lm_model4_ci <- lm_model4_results_all$ci_fixed
  model_list[["crpinfection"]] <- model4
  
  result_summary <- rbind(
    lm_model1_results,
    lm_model2_results,
    lm_model3_results,
    lm_model4_results
  )
  
  ci_fixed <- list(
    Original = lm_model1_ci,
    crp = lm_model2_ci,
    infection = lm_model3_ci,
    crpinfection = lm_model4_ci
  )
  
  print(ci_fixed)
  
  return(list(result_summary = result_summary, 
              ci_fixed = ci_fixed, 
              model_list = model_list))
}
```

```{r dbs-linear-regression}
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
      )
  }


  cat("Running linear regression model for:", target_var, "========================================\n")
  # first run samples with infectious symptoms as covariate, ALL including outliers
  cat("Model 1: Run all samples with infectious symptoms as covariate------------\n")
  
  print(describeBy(df_tmp %>% dplyr::select(contains(target_var)), 
                   group = df_tmp$sr_scr_rand_group, digits = 3))
  
  lm_formula1a <- as.formula(paste0('dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ sr_base_curhealth_2infection + sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection + dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group'))
  lm_model1a <- lm(lm_formula1a, data = df_tmp)
  lm_model_summary1a <- summary(lm_model1a)
  
  cat('\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\nModel 1A: ', 'dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ sr_base_curhealth_2infection + sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection + dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group', '\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\n')
  
  print(lm_model_summary1a)
  print(plot_residuals(lm_model1a, df_tmp, "Model 1A"))
  
  lm_model_1a_d <- compute_effect_size_wide(estimation = lm_model1a,
                                            data = df_tmp %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(base_var)) & !is.na(!!sym(fu_var))),
                                            base_var = base_var,
                                            outcome_var = fu_var,
                                            preMI = "Y",
                                            ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model1a_results_all <- dbs_results(est = lm_model1a,
                                    target_var = target_var,
                                    smd_results =lm_model_1a_d,
                                    model_name = "Original",
                                    ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model1a_results <- lm_model1a_results_all$summary_table
  lm_model1a_ci <- lm_model1a_results_all$ci_fixed
  model_list[["Original"]] <- lm_model1a
  
  # Model 2: excluding CRP>10, infectious symptoms as covariate 
  cat("\nModel 2: Re-run excluding CRP>10 with infectious symptoms as covariate------------\n")
  print(describeBy(df_tmp_exc2 %>% dplyr::select(contains(target_var)), group = df_tmp_exc2$sr_scr_rand_group, digits = 3))
  
  lm_model2a <- lm(lm_formula1a, data = df_tmp_exc2)
  lm_model_summary2a <- summary(lm_model2a)
  
  cat('\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\nModel 2A: ', 'dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ sr_base_curhealth_2infection + sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection + dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group', '\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\n')

  print(lm_model_summary2a)
  print(plot_residuals(lm_model2a, df_tmp, "Model 2A"))
  
  lm_model_2a_d <- compute_effect_size_wide(estimation = lm_model2a,
                                            data = df_tmp_exc2 %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                                                                            !is.na(!!sym(fu_var))),
                                            base_var = base_var,
                                            outcome_var = fu_var,
                                            preMI = "Y",
                                            ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model2a_results_all <- dbs_results(est = lm_model2a,
                                    target_var = target_var,
                                    smd_results =lm_model_2a_d,
                                    model_name = "Excluding CRP>10 with infectious symptoms as covariate",
                                    ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model2a_results <- lm_model2a_results_all$summary_table
  lm_model2a_ci <- lm_model2a_results_all$ci_fixed
  model_list[["crp"]] <- lm_model2a 
  
  # Model 3 excludes those w 2+ infectious symptoms at baseline or 3mo 
  cat("\nModel 3: Re-run excluding those with 2+ infectious symptoms at baseline OR 3mo------------\n")

  df_tmp_exc3 <- df_tmp %>%  
    filter(sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection == 0 & 
             sr_base_curhealth_2infection == 0)
  
  print(describeBy(df_tmp_exc3 %>% dplyr::select(contains(target_var)), group = df_tmp_exc3$sr_scr_rand_group, digits = 3))
  
  lm_formula3a <- as.formula(paste0('dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group'))
  lm_model3a <- lm(lm_formula3a, data = df_tmp_exc3)
  lm_model_summary3a <- summary(lm_model3a)
  
  cat('\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\nModel 3A: ', 'dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group', '\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\n')
  
  print(lm_model_summary3a)
  print(plot_residuals(lm_model3a, df_tmp, "Model 3A"))
  
  lm_model_3a_d <- compute_effect_size_wide(estimation = lm_model3a,
                                            data = df_tmp_exc3 %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                                                                            !is.na(!!sym(fu_var))),
                                            base_var = base_var,
                                            outcome_var = fu_var,
                                            preMI = "Y",
                                            ref_level = ref_level)
  
  lm_model3a_results_all <- dbs_results(est = lm_model3a,
                                    target_var = target_var,
                                    smd_results =lm_model_3a_d,
                                    model_name = "Excluding those with 2+ infectious symptoms at Baseline or Week 17",
                                    ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model3a_results <- lm_model3a_results_all$summary_table
  lm_model3a_ci <- lm_model3a_results_all$ci_fixed
  model_list[["infection"]] <- lm_model3a
  
    # Model 4 excludes CRP>10 and those w 2+ infectious symptoms at baseline or 3mo 
  cat("\nModel 4: Re-run excluding CRP>10 and those with 2+ infectious symptoms at baseline OR 3mo------------\n")

  df_tmp_exc4 <- df_tmp_exc2 %>%  
    filter(sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection == 0 & 
             sr_base_curhealth_2infection == 0)
  
  print(describeBy(df_tmp_exc4 %>% dplyr::select(contains(target_var)), 
                   group = df_tmp_exc4$sr_scr_rand_group, digits = 3))
  
  lm_formula4a <- as.formula(paste0('dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group'))
  lm_model4a <- lm(lm_formula4a, data = df_tmp_exc4)
  lm_model_summary4a <- summary(lm_model4a)
  
  cat('\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\nModel 4A: ', 'dbs_3mo_', target_var, ' ~ dbs_base_', target_var, ' + sr_scr_rand_group', '\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\n')
  
  print(lm_model_summary4a)
  print(plot_residuals(lm_model4a, df_tmp, "Model 4A"))
  
  lm_model_4a_d <- compute_effect_size_wide(estimation = lm_model4a,
                                            data = df_tmp_exc4 %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(base_var)) &
                                                                            !is.na(!!sym(fu_var))),
                                            base_var = base_var,
                                            outcome_var = fu_var,
                                            preMI = "Y",
                                            ref_level = ref_level)
  
  lm_model4a_results_all <- dbs_results(est = lm_model4a,
                                    target_var = target_var,
                                    smd_results =lm_model_4a_d,
                                    model_name = "Excluding CRP>10 and those with 2+ infectious symptoms at Baseline or Week 17",
                                    ref_level = ref_level)
  lm_model4a_results <- lm_model4a_results_all$summary_table
  lm_model4a_ci <- lm_model4a_results_all$ci_fixed
  model_list[["crpinfection"]] <- lm_model4a
  
  result_summary <- rbind(
    lm_model1a_results,
    lm_model2a_results,
    lm_model3a_results,
    lm_model4a_results
  )
  
  ci_fixed <- list(
    Original = lm_model1a_ci,
    crp = lm_model2a_ci,
    infection = lm_model3a_ci,
    crpinfection = lm_model4a_ci
  )
  print(ci_fixed)
  
  return(list(result_summary = result_summary, 
              ci_fixed = ci_fixed, 
              model_list = model_list))
}
```

## Function: FDR correction
```{r fx_fdr_correction}
fdr_correction <- function(summary_data, group_vars = c('var_prefix', 'model_type','comparison', 'timepoint')){
  fdr_corrected_p <- summary_data %>% 
    mutate(var_prefix = sapply(outcome, map_prefix)) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%    
    mutate(p_value_fdr = {
      idx <- outcome != "phq8_sum"
      fdr_vals <- rep(NA_real_, n())
      fdr_vals[idx] <- p.adjust(p_value[idx], method = "fdr")
      fdr_vals[!idx] <- p_value[!idx]   # PHQ8 keeps original p
      fdr_vals
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  return(fdr_corrected_p)
}
```

## Load df
```{r load_df}
df <- read.csv(file = './Data/BeWell_primaryPaper_deid.csv', na.strings = c("NaN", "", "NA")) %>%
  rename(id = rand_id) %>%
  mutate(sr_scr_rand_group =  factor(sr_scr_rand_group,
                                 levels = c('hmp_full', 'hmp_active', 'uc'))) %>% 
  mutate(gender_combined = recode_values(gender_combined,
                                      'Woman' ~ 0,
                                      'Man' ~ 1,
                                      'Other' ~ 2
                                      ),
         race_nhwhite = recode_values(race_nhwhite,
                                      'No' ~ 0,
                                      'Yes' ~ 1),
         education_level = recode_values(education_level,
                                         "not college graduate" ~ 0,
                                         "college graduate" ~ 1),
         income_level = recode_values(income_level,
                                      "below median" ~ 0,
                                      "above median" ~ 1)) %>% 
  mutate(gender_combined = factor(gender_combined,
                                  levels = 0:2,
                                  labels = c('Woman', 
                                             'Man',
                                             'Other')),
         race_nhwhite = factor(race_nhwhite,
                               levels = 0:1,
                               labels = c('No',
                                          'Yes')),
         education_level = factor(education_level,
                                  levels = 0:1,
                                  labels = c('not_college_graduate',
                                             'college_graduate')),
         income_level = factor(income_level,
                               levels = 0:1,
                               labels = c('below_median',
                                          'above_median'))) %>% 
  rename_with(
    ~ str_replace(., 
                  "^vlg_(.*?)_facial_(.*)$", 
                  "vlg_\\1_vlg_\\2"),
    .cols = matches("^vlg_.*_facial_")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(sr_base_medTherapy_bin = case_when(
    rowSums(across(contains('_base_medTherapy')), na.rm = FALSE) > 0 ~ 1, 
    rowSums(across(contains('_base_medTherapy')), na.rm = FALSE) == 0 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA),
    sr_pw4_medTherapy_bin = case_when(
    rowSums(across(contains('_pw4_medTherapy')), na.rm = FALSE) > 0 ~ 1, 
    rowSums(across(contains('_pw4_medTherapy')), na.rm = FALSE) == 0 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA),
    sr_3mo_medTherapy_bin = case_when(
    rowSums(across(contains('_3mo_medTherapy')), na.rm = FALSE) > 0 ~ 1, 
    rowSums(across(contains('_3mo_medTherapy')), na.rm = FALSE) == 0 ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA)
    )
```

Update df with infectious symptoms variables
```{r dbs-covariates, message = FALSE}
base_covariates <- c('sr_base_curhealth_coldflu',
                     'sr_base_curhealth_fever',
                     'sr_base_curhealth_nightsweat',
                     'sr_base_curhealth_gi',
                     'sr_base_curhealth_bloodyStool',
                     'sr_base_curhealth_frequentPee',
                     'sr_base_curhealth_rashy',
                     'sr_base_curhealth_other')

fu_covariates <- c('sr_3mo_curhealth_coldflu',
                   'sr_3mo_curhealth_fever',
                   'sr_3mo_curhealth_nightsweat',
                   'sr_3mo_curhealth_gi',
                   'sr_3mo_curhealth_bloodyStool',
                   'sr_3mo_curhealth_frequentPee',
                   'sr_3mo_curhealth_rashy',
                   'sr_3mo_curhealth_other')

df <- df |> 
  # infection counts at baseline and 3mo: 
  mutate(sr_base_curhealth_infectionCount = 
           rowSums(across(all_of(base_covariates)), na.rm = TRUE),
         sr_3mo_curhealth_infectionCount = 
           rowSums(across(all_of(fu_covariates)), na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  
  # binary vars for infection symp: 
  mutate(sr_base_curhealth_infection = 
           if_else(sr_base_curhealth_infectionCount >= 1, 1, 
                   sr_base_curhealth_infectionCount),
         sr_3mo_curhealth_infection = 
           if_else(sr_3mo_curhealth_infectionCount >= 1, 1, 
                   sr_3mo_curhealth_infectionCount)) |> 
  
  # per Thom's advice, binary var for those w 2+ baseline infec symp:
  mutate(sr_base_curhealth_2infection = 
           case_when(sr_base_curhealth_infectionCount >= 2 ~ 1,
                     sr_base_curhealth_infectionCount < 2 ~ 0, 
                     TRUE ~ sr_base_curhealth_infectionCount),
         sr_3mo_curhealth_2infection = 
           case_when(sr_3mo_curhealth_infectionCount >= 2 ~ 1,
                     sr_3mo_curhealth_infectionCount < 2 ~ 0, 
                     TRUE ~ sr_3mo_curhealth_infectionCount))
```

## Descriptive statistics of outcomes by group

```{r all_vars_desc}
title_order <- names(target_titles)

         median_IQR = " ") %>%

      everything(),
      list(
        IQR = ~ paste0(sprintf("%.2f", quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)), " - ",  sprintf("%.2f", quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)))
      ),
      .names = "{.col}"
    )
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "Variable",
               values_to = "IQR")
  

desc_table <- df %>% 
  mutate(dbs_base_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB = ifelse(id %in% dbs_exc_ids, NA, dbs_base_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB),
         dbs_3mo_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB = ifelse(id %in% dbs_exc_ids, NA, dbs_3mo_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB)) %>% # exclude IL6 cases with tech errors
  dplyr::select(all_of(c(sr_all,
                         dbs_all,
                         mib_all,
                         vlg_all,
                         mst_all))) %>% 
  psych::describe() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, n, mean, sd, median
                ) %>%
  mutate(mean = as.character(sprintf("%.2f", mean)),
         sd = as.character(sprintf("%.2f", sd)),
         median = as.character(sprintf("%.2f", median))) %>% 
  left_join(desc_table_IQR) |> 
  mutate(median_IQR = paste0(median, " (", IQR, ")")) %>% 
  full_join(desc_table_medTherapy) %>% 
  mutate(n = as.integer(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    Title = sapply(Variable, map_title, title_map = target_titles),
    Time = case_when(
      str_detect(Variable, '_base_') ~ 'Baseline',
      str_detect(Variable, '_pw1_') ~ 'Week 1',
      str_detect(Variable, '_pw2_') ~ 'Week 2',
      str_detect(Variable, '_pw3_') ~ 'Week 3',
      str_detect(Variable, '_pw4_') ~ 'Week 4',
      str_detect(Variable, '_3mo_') ~ 'Week 17'
    ),
    Measure = paste0(Time, ' ', Title)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Title_order = factor(Title, levels = target_titles),
    Time_order = factor(Time, levels = time_order)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Title_order, Time_order) %>%
  dplyr::select(Title, Time, n, mean, sd, median_IQR
                ) %>% 
  rename('Mean/Count' = mean,
         'SD/%' = sd,
         'Median (IQR)' = median_IQR)

# By group
group_lvs <- as.character(levels(df$sr_scr_rand_group))
desc_table_grouped <- desc_table

for (group_lv in group_lvs) {
  desc_table_medTherapy_tmp <- df %>%
    filter(sr_scr_rand_group == group_lv) %>%
    dplyr::select(contains("medTherapy")) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(variable) %>%
    summarize(
      n = sum(!is.na(value)),
      mean = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), # total count of ppts with that medication/therapy, naming as mean for merging purpose
      sd = sprintf("%.1f%%", mean / n * 100) # percentage of ppts with that medication/therapy, naming as sd for merging purpose
    ) %>% 
    mutate(mean = sprintf("%.0f", mean),
         median_IQR = " ") %>% 
    rename(Variable = variable)
  
  desc_table_IQR_tmp <- df %>% 
    filter(sr_scr_rand_group == group_lv) %>%
    mutate(dbs_base_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB = ifelse(id %in% dbs_exc_ids, NA, dbs_base_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB),
           dbs_3mo_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB = ifelse(id %in% dbs_exc_ids, NA, dbs_3mo_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB)) %>% # exclude IL6 cases with tech errors
    dplyr::select(all_of(c(sr_all,
                         dbs_all,
                         mib_all,
                         vlg_all,
                         mst_all))) |> 
    summarise(
      across(
        everything(),
        list(
          IQR = ~ paste0(sprintf("%.2f", quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)), " - ",  sprintf("%.2f", quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)))
        ),
        .names = "{.col}"
      )
    ) |> 
    pivot_longer(everything(),
                 names_to = "Variable",
                 values_to = "IQR")
  
  desc_table_tmp <- df %>%
    mutate(dbs_base_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB = ifelse(id %in% dbs_exc_ids, NA, dbs_base_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB),
           dbs_3mo_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB = ifelse(id %in% dbs_exc_ids, NA, dbs_3mo_cyto_il6_dbs_mean_AB)) %>% # exclude IL6 cases with tech errors
    filter(sr_scr_rand_group == group_lv) %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(c(sr_all,
                           dbs_all,
                           mib_all,
                           vlg_all,
                           mst_all))) %>%
    psych::describe() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
    dplyr::select(Variable, n, mean, sd, median
                  ) %>%
    mutate(mean = as.character(sprintf("%.2f", mean)),
           sd = as.character(sprintf("%.2f", sd)),
         median = as.character(sprintf("%.2f", median))) %>% 
    left_join(desc_table_IQR) %>% 
    mutate(median_IQR = paste0(median, " (", IQR, ")")) %>% 
    full_join(desc_table_medTherapy_tmp) %>% 
    mutate(n = as.integer(n)) %>%
    mutate(
      Title = sapply(Variable, map_title, title_map = target_titles),
      Time = case_when(
        str_detect(Variable, '_base_') ~ 'Baseline',
        str_detect(Variable, '_pw1_') ~ 'Week 1',
        str_detect(Variable, '_pw2_') ~ 'Week 2',
        str_detect(Variable, '_pw3_') ~ 'Week 3',
        str_detect(Variable, '_pw4_') ~ 'Week 4',
        str_detect(Variable, '_3mo_') ~ 'Week 17'
      ),
      Measure = paste0(Time, ' ', Title)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Title_order = factor(Title, levels = target_titles),
      Time_order = factor(Time, levels = time_order)
      ) %>%
    arrange(Title_order, Time_order) %>% 
    dplyr::select(Title, Time, n, mean, sd, median_IQR
                  ) %>%
  rename('Mean' = mean,
         'SD' = sd,
         'Median (IQR)' = median_IQR) %>% 
    rename_with(~paste0(., "_", group_lv), -c(Title, Time))
  
  desc_table_grouped <- left_join(desc_table_grouped, desc_table_tmp)
}

# Build gt table
gt_table <- desc_table_grouped %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Title") %>% 
  cols_label(Time = "Outcome/Time point") %>% 
  fmt_number(columns = matches("(^|_)n(_|$)"), decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric) & !matches("(^|_)n(_|$)"), decimals = 2) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "All Participants",
    columns = c(n, 'Mean/Count', 'SD/%', 'Median (IQR)'
                )
  )

for (group_lv in group_lvs) {
  label_list <- setNames(
    list("n", 'Mean/Count', 'SD/%', 'Median (IQR)'
         ),
    c(paste0("n_", group_lv),
      paste0("Mean_", group_lv),
      paste0("SD_", group_lv),
      paste0("Median (IQR)_", group_lv)
      )
  )
  
  if (group_lv == 'hmp_full'){
    lv_name <- 'HMP-Full'
    } else if (group_lv == "hmp_active"){
      lv_name <- 'HMP-Psychoed'
    } else if (group_lv == "uc"){
      lv_name <- 'Usual Care'
      }
  
  gt_table <- gt_table %>%
    tab_spanner(
      label = paste(lv_name),
      id = paste0("spanner_", group_lv),
      columns = c(
        paste0("n_", group_lv),
        paste0("Mean_", group_lv),
        paste0("SD_", group_lv),
        paste0("Median (IQR)_", group_lv)
      )
    ) %>%
    cols_label(.list = label_list)
}

gt_table <- gt_table %>%
    cols_align(
          align = "center",
          columns = -2
          )
gt_table
```


# Multiple imputation for long format data

```{r mi_df}
df_pre_mi <- df %>% dplyr::select(id,
                                  sr_scr_rand_group,
                                  sr_scr_scr_age, 
                                  gender_combined, 
                                  race_nhwhite, 
                                  education_level, 
                                  income_level, 
                                  all_of(c(sr_all,
                                           vlg_all
                                           )))

var_list <- df_pre_mi %>% 
  dplyr::select(-id,
                -sr_scr_rand_group,
                -sr_scr_scr_age, 
                -gender_combined, 
                -race_nhwhite, 
                -education_level, 
                -income_level) %>% 
  names()
```

Check for missingness: over 10% for all outcome variables, except at baseline.

```{r missing_check}
df_pre_mi %>% summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.))))

for (outcome in outcome_vars){
  df_tmp <- df_pre_mi %>% dplyr::select(ends_with(outcome))
  print(outcome)
  print(md.pattern(df_tmp))
  print(names(df_tmp))
  rm(df_tmp, outcome)
}
```

convert into long format

```{r mi}
df_mi_long_keep_vars <- c('sr_scr_rand_group',
                          'sr_scr_scr_age',
                          'gender_combined',
                          'race_nhwhite',
                          'income_level',
                          'education_level')

all_imp_vars <- c('sr_scr_scr_age',
                  'gender_combined',
                  'race_nhwhite',
                  'income_level',
                  'education_level',
                  piecewise_vars)

df_pre_mi_long <- convert_long_format(df_tmp = df_pre_mi, 
                                      target_var_strings = piecewise_vars, 
                                      constant_vars = df_mi_long_keep_vars)

df_pre_mi_long <- df_pre_mi_long %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(all_imp_vars), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 1, 0), .names = "missing_{.col}"))
```


# Actual Imputation

With range restriction

```{r impute}
value_range <- list("phq8_sum" = c(0, 27), 
                    "gad7_total" = c(0, 21),
                    "flourishing_flourishing" = c(0, 10),
                    "promisSleep_tScore" = c(0, 77.6),
                    "linguistic_negative_sentiment" = c(0, 100),
                    "linguistic_i" = c(0, 100)
                    )

df_mi_restricted <- imputating_missing_long(df_tmp = df_pre_mi_long, 
                                            vars = all_imp_vars, 
                                            restrict_range = "Y",
                                            range_matrix = value_range)
```



Save the completed imputed data

```{r save_imputed}
df_og_imp <- complete(df_mi_restricted, action = "long", include = TRUE)# with original data
df_imp <- complete(df_mi_restricted, action = "long", include = FALSE) # without original data
## Check number of missing values
table(is.na(df_og_imp))
table(is.na(df_imp)) # all should be FALSE
```


## Piecewise models and MNAR sensitivity analysis
Reference group = HMP-Full

Step 1: Scale the imputed values (80% and 90% / 110% and 120%) using scale_imputed_values function.
Step 2: Run the regression analysis with the original data, the imputed and scaled values. 
Step 3: Run FDR-correction

```{r piecewise_imputed_scaled}
df_og_imp_scaled <- df_og_imp
piecewise_results <- list()
piecewise_summaries <- list()

for (piecewise_var in piecewise_vars){
  #Step 1
  df_og_imp_scaled <- scale_imputed_values_long(df_og_imp_scaled, piecewise_var)
  
  #Step 2
  piecewise_results[[piecewise_var]] <- run_sensitivity_imputed_long(df_og_imp_scaled, 
                                                                     piecewise_var, 
                                                                     return_table = TRUE)
  piecewise_summary <- piecewise_results[[piecewise_var]]$summary_table
  piecewise_summaries <- dplyr::bind_rows(piecewise_summaries, piecewise_summary)
}

print(piecewise_summaries)

#Step 3
piecewise_fdr_corrected <- fdr_correction(summary_data = piecewise_summaries, 
                                          group_vars = c('var_prefix', 
                                                         'model_type',
                                                         'comparison', 
                                                         'timepoint'))
View(piecewise_fdr_corrected)
```

## Simple linear regression and MNAR sensitivity analysis for MST
Reference group = HMP-Full

Step 1: Scale the imputed values (80% and 90% / 110% and 120%) using scale_imputed_values function.
Step 2: Run the regression analysis with the original data, the imputed and scaled values. 

MST - Use the results from the imputed model due to high level of missingness
```{r mst_imputed_scaled}
df_og_imp_mst_scaled <- df_og_imp_mst
mst_results <- list()
mst_summaries <- list()


for (mst_var in mst_vars){
  #step 1
  df_og_imp_mst_scaled <- scale_imputed_values_wide(df_og_imp_mst_scaled,
                                                    mst_var)
  
  # Step 2
  mst_results[[mst_var]] <- run_sensitivity_imputed_wide(df, 
                                                df_og_imp_mst_scaled, 
                                                mst_var,
                                                return_table = TRUE)
  
  mst_summary <- mst_results[[mst_var]]$summary_table
  mst_summaries <- dplyr::bind_rows(mst_summaries, mst_summary)
}

print(mst_summaries)

mst_fdr_corrected <- fdr_correction(summary_data = mst_summaries, 
                                    group_vars = c('var_prefix', 
                                                   'model_type',
                                                   'comparison', 
                                                   'timepoint'))
View(mst_fdr_corrected)
```

# Simple linear regression and sensitivity analysis for microbiome
```{r table_dbs_sens_summary}
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(sr_base_healthHx_antibiotics_bin = case_when(sr_base_healthHx_antibiotics == 'yes' ~ 1,
                                                      sr_base_healthHx_antibiotics == 'no' ~ 0,
                                                      TRUE ~ NA))
mib_models <- list()
mib_summaries <- list()

for (mib_var in mib_vars){
  cat('\n\n===Original model===\n\n')
  mib_models[[mib_var]] <- run_lm_og_wide(outcome = mib_var, return_table = TRUE)
  mib_summary <- mib_models[[mib_var]]$results_summary
  mib_summaries <- dplyr::bind_rows(mib_summaries, mib_summary)
  
  cat('\n\n===Excluding outliers > median + 1.5xIQR===\n\n')
  run_lm_og_wide(outcome = mib_var,
                 exc_outlier = TRUE)
  
  cat('\n\n===Excluding those taking antidepressant medications at baseline===\n\n')
  run_lm_og_wide(df %>% 
                   filter(sr_base_medTherapy_medAntiDep != 1), # update file to the new filtered file
                 outcome = mib_var,
                 exc_outlier = TRUE)
  
  cat('\n\n===Excluding those taking antibiotics in the past year===\n\n')
  run_lm_og_wide(df %>% 
                   filter(sr_base_healthHx_antibiotics_bin != 1), # update file to the new filtered file
                 outcome = mib_var,
                 exc_outlier = TRUE)
}

# FDR-Correction
mib_fdr_corrected <- fdr_correction(mib_summaries,
                                    group_vars = c('var_prefix',
                                                   'comparison',
                                                   'timepoint'))
print(mib_fdr_corrected)
```

### HMP usage
```{r hmp_usage}
# Usage by group
summary(lm(hmp_intervention_sum_days ~ group, data = df))
confint(lm(hmp_intervention_sum_days ~ group, data = df))
summary(lm(scale(hmp_intervention_sum_days) ~ group, data = df))
confint(lm(scale(hmp_intervention_sum_days) ~ group, data = df))

summary(lm(hmp_followup_sum_days ~ group, data = df))
confint(lm(hmp_followup_sum_days ~ group, data = df))
summary(lm(scale(hmp_followup_sum_days) ~ group, data = df))
confint(lm(scale(hmp_followup_sum_days) ~ group, data = df))

# Usage x time X group interaction
hmp_2way <- lmer(phq8_sum ~ time1*sr_scr_rand_group + time1*hmp_intervention_sum_days + time2*sr_scr_rand_group + time2*hmp_followup_sum_days + (time1|id), data = df_long)
summary(hmp_2way)
confint(hmp_2way)

summary(hmp_3way)
confint(hmp_3way)
```

```{r poisson}
## ---- config ----------------------------------------------------------
d        <- df_long
grp      <- "sr_scr_rand_group"   # grouping/arm variable
max_score <- 24                    # PHQ-8 upper bound
wts      <- c(4, 1)                # weights on (time1:grp, time2:grp)

## ---- models ----------------------------------------------------------
rhs <- paste0("time1*", grp, " + time2*", grp, " + (time1|id)")

m.gaus <- glmmTMB(as.formula(paste("phq8_sum ~", rhs)), data = d, family = gaussian)
m.pois <- glmmTMB(as.formula(paste("phq8_sum ~", rhs)), data = d, family = poisson)

check_overdispersion(m.pois)

## ---- AIC / BIC -------------------------------------------------------
mods <- list(Gaussian = m.gaus, Poisson = m.pois)

ic <- data.frame(
  model  = names(mods),
  df     = sapply(mods, function(x) attr(logLik(x), "df")),
  logLik = sapply(mods, function(x) as.numeric(logLik(x))),
  AIC    = sapply(mods, AIC),
  BIC    = sapply(mods, BIC),
  row.names = NULL
)
print(ic[order(ic$AIC), ])

summary(m.pois)

## ---- glht equivalent: 4*(time1:grp) + 1*(time2:grp) ------------------
contrast_test <- function(model, group_term, weights = wts,
                          exponentiate = FALSE, label = NULL) {
  
  if (inherits(model, "glmmTMB")) {
    b <- glmmTMB::fixef(model)$cond; V <- vcov(model)$cond
  } else {
    b <- lme4::fixef(model);         V <- as.matrix(vcov(model))
  }
  
  tc   <- c(paste0("time1:", group_term), paste0("time2:", group_term))
  flip <- !tc %in% names(b)
  if (any(flip)) {
    alt <- c(paste0(group_term, ":time1"), paste0(group_term, ":time2"))
    tc[flip] <- alt[flip]
  }
  if (!all(tc %in% names(b)))
    stop("Not found: ", paste(setdiff(tc, names(b)), collapse = ", "),
         "\nAvailable: ", paste(names(b), collapse = ", "))
  
  K <- setNames(numeric(length(b)), names(b)); K[tc] <- weights
  K <- matrix(K, nrow = 1, dimnames = list("contrast", names(b)))
  
  est <- as.vector(K %*% b)
  se  <- as.vector(sqrt(K %*% V %*% t(K)))
  z   <- est / se
  
  out <- data.frame(
    contrast = if (is.null(label)) paste(tc, collapse = " + ") else label,
    estimate = est, se = se, z = z, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z)),
    ci_lower = est - qnorm(.975) * se,
    ci_upper = est + qnorm(.975) * se, row.names = NULL)
  
  if (exponentiate)
    out <- cbind(out["contrast"], ratio = exp(out$estimate),
                 r_lower = exp(out$ci_lower), r_upper = exp(out$ci_upper),
                 out[c("se", "z", "p")])
  out
}

## ---- apply across models --------------------------------------------
active <- paste0(grp, "hmp_active")
uc     <- paste0(grp, "uc")

rbind(
  contrast_test(m.gaus, active, label = "Gaussian: full vs active"),
  contrast_test(m.gaus, uc,     label = "Gaussian: full vs UC")
)

rbind(
  contrast_test(m.pois, active, exponentiate = TRUE, label = "Poisson: full vs active"),
  contrast_test(m.pois, uc,     exponentiate = TRUE, label = "Poisson: full vs UC") 
)

rbind(
  contrast_test(m.pois, active, exponentiate = FALSE, label = "Poisson: full vs active"),
  contrast_test(m.pois, uc,     exponentiate = FALSE, label = "Poisson: full vs UC") 
)


##Posterior predictive check on the marginal distribution ---
sim.g <- simulate(m.gaus, nsim = 500)
sim.p <- simulate(m.pois, nsim = 500)

obs.tab <- table(factor(dat$value, levels = 0:24)) / nrow(dat)

pp.tab <- function(simlist) {
  m <- sapply(simlist, function(y)
    table(factor(round(pmax(y, 0)), levels = 0:24)) / length(y))
  data.frame(value = 0:24,
             mean = rowMeans(m),
             lwr  = apply(m, 1, quantile, .025),
             upr  = apply(m, 1, quantile, .975))
}

pp.g <- pp.tab(sim.g); pp.p <- pp.tab(sim.p)

## observed vs predicted frequency, both models
pdf("~/Data/poisson_vs_gaussian.pdf", width = 7, height = 5) 
plot(0:24, as.numeric(obs.tab), type = "h", lwd = 3,
     xlab = "PHQ-8", ylab = "Proportion")
lines(pp.g$value, pp.g$mean, col = "red",  lwd = 2)
lines(pp.p$value, pp.p$mean, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
legend("topright", c("Observed","Gaussian","Poisson"),
       col = c("black","red","blue"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
dev.off()
```
